descripcion_larga: Konductra on NDS challenges your reflexes. Use the stylus to draw paths between blocks, triggering massive chain reactions in this rhythmic and colorful experience.

objetivo: Learn how to care for a newborn and track development.
descripcion_corta: A helpful guide and simulation for new parents.
descripcion_larga: Konnichiwa Akachan provides practical advice on baby care. From feeding schedules to bathing tips, it’s a supportive tool for those expecting or with a new arrival.

objetivo: Compete in a fast-paced quiz show against quirky rivals.
descripcion_corta: A fun and energetic Japanese trivia challenge.
descripcion_larga: Kono Quiz Yarou!! features thousands of questions across multiple categories. Use the touch screen to buzz in and prove you are the smartest in the room!

objetivo: Improve concentration and focus for primary school kids.

descripcion_larga: Konzentration und Aufmerksamkeit 1.-4. Klasse uses fun puzzles to build mental discipline. These scientifically-backed exercises help children improve their focus in and out of school.

nombre: Kore de Haji o Kakanai - Ashita Tsukaeru DS Business Manner (Japan)
objetivo: Master professional etiquette and Japanese business manners.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive guide to success in the corporate world.
descripcion_larga: Ashita Tsukaeru DS Business Manner teaches everything from formal greetings to proper business card exchange. An essential trainer for job hunters and young professionals.

objetivo: Create professional electronic music with a legendary synth.
descripcion_corta: A powerful music creation tool based on the Korg MS-10.
descripcion_larga: Korg DS-10 Synthesizer turns your NDS into a production studio. With dual oscillators and a 16-step sequencer, it's a legitimate tool for musicians and synth enthusiasts.

objetivo: Create professional electronic music with a legendary synth.
descripcion_corta: A powerful music creation tool based on the Korg MS-10.
descripcion_larga: Korg DS-10 Synthesizer (Japan) provides the same deep synthesis features. Create, save, and share your tracks with a community of portable music makers.

objetivo: Create professional electronic music with a legendary synth.
descripcion_corta: A powerful music creation tool based on the Korg MS-10.
descripcion_larga: Korg DS-10 Synthesizer (USA) allows for complex sound design using the touch screen. It's an iconic piece of software that pushed the NDS audio hardware to its limits.

objetivo: Create even more complex tracks with expanded features.
descripcion_corta: A DSi-enhanced version of the legendary synthesizer.
descripcion_larga: Korg DS-10+ takes advantage of the DSi hardware for double the synth power. Features 4 tracks and improved effects, making it the ultimate mobile synth for the DS family.

objetivo: Compose full songs using 8-part multi-timbral sounds.
descripcion_corta: A high-end music workstation based on the Korg M1.
descripcion_larga: Korg M01 features over 300 sounds and a detailed sequencer. Perfect for composing entire tracks on the go, it captures the essence of the classic 80s workstation for the NDS.

objetivo: Arrange "moji" (letters) to form words and clear the board.
descripcion_corta: A legendary and addictive Japanese word-puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Kotoba no Puzzle: Mojipittan DS challenges your vocabulary. Connect letters in all directions to create words and fill the stage in this charming and brain-teasing classic.

descripcion_corta: A gritty Mahjong adventure based on the Mukoubuchi manga.
descripcion_larga: Kou Rate Ura Mahjong Retsuden features intense matches and a dramatic story. Face off against skilled gamblers and master the art of the tile to clear your debts.

nombre: Kou-chan no Shiawase! Kantan! Oryouri Recipe (Japan)
objetivo: Learn simple and happy recipes from chef Kou-chan.
descripcion_corta: A practical and friendly digital cookbook for beginners.
descripcion_larga: Kou-chan no Shiawase! Oryouri Recipe features easy-to-follow guides for everyday meals. With voice instructions and shopping lists, it makes cooking fun and accessible.

objetivo: Battle giant beetles in a high-energy wrestling arena.

descripcion_larga: Kouchuu Kakutou lets you choose your favorite beetle and fight for the championship. Use the touch screen to execute powerful moves and knock out your insect rivals.

nombre: Kouchuu Ouja Mushi King - Greatest Champion e no Michi 2 (Japan)

descripcion_larga: Experience the thrill of beetle combat in Mushiking: Greatest Champion e no Michi 2. Collect rare beetles, customize their skills with cards, and master the rock-paper-scissors battle system to dominate the championship circuit in this classic Japanese NDS title.

descripcion_corta: Realistic high school baseball management sim for NDS.
descripcion_larga: Koukou Yakyuu-dou DS puts you in the dugout as a high school baseball coach. Manage practice schedules, recruit talented players, and make critical tactical decisions during matches to lead your team to victory in the prestigious national tournament.

gameplay: Choice-based visual novel focusing on negotiation and psychological tactics.

descripcion_corta: Intense police negotiation thriller and visual novel.
descripcion_larga: Step into the shoes of a professional negotiator in Koushounin DS. Use the Nintendo DS touch screen to select the right dialogue choices, analyze criminal psychology, and resolve dangerous standoffs in this gripping, text-heavy detective adventure.

gameplay: Fast-paced strategic card battling with touch-screen controls.

descripcion_corta: Nintendo's cult-classic strategic card battle game.
descripcion_larga: Kousoku Card Battle: Card Hero is the high-speed evolution of the beloved franchise. Featuring deep tactical gameplay, players must manage resources and position monsters strategically to defeat opponents in a quest to become the top-ranked card hero.

objetivo: Solve hundreds of crossword puzzles across various difficulty levels.
descripcion_corta: German-language crossword puzzle collection for DS.

descripcion_corta: Strategic "Game of Go" style conquest in feudal Japan.

objetivo: Care for your baby seal and participate in mini-games.
descripcion_corta: Relaxing seal-raising simulation for all ages.
descripcion_larga: Kupuu!! Mamegoma! is a gentle simulation game where you raise the adorable palm-sized seals known as Mamegoma. Feed them, clean them, and play mini-games to bond with your aquatic pets in this charming and stress-free Japanese title.

nombre: Kurayami no Hate de Kimi o Matsu (Japan)

objetivo: Solve the mystery of a haunted school and find romance.
descripcion_corta: A dark, romantic suspense visual novel for a female audience.
descripcion_larga: Kurayami no Hate de Kimi o Matsu (Waiting for You at the Edge of Darkness) is a gripping Otome game. Trapped in an abandoned school, you must solve puzzles and make choices that determine your survival and your romantic destiny with one of several male companions.

objetivo: Conquer the island by breeding and commanding colonies of "Kurikin."
descripcion_corta: Unique real-time strategy with microscopic creatures.
descripcion_larga: Kurikin: Nano Island Story is a hidden gem on the DS. Use the stylus to guide colonies of bacteria-like creatures in real-time battles. Manage different species with unique strengths and weaknesses to dominate the microscopic ecosystem of Nano Island.

descripcion_corta: A colorful and quirky action-puzzler sequel.
descripcion_larga: Kurikuri DS: Otasuke Island brings the chaotic puzzle fun of the original to the handheld. Use the dual screens and touch controls to solve environmental puzzles and outmaneuver rivals in this vibrant, high-energy title from FromSoftware.

descripcion_corta: A gothic mystery adventure set in Victorian London.

descripcion_corta: Fast-paced chameleon-themed puzzle action.

descripcion_corta: US version of the gravity-shifting puzzle hit.

descripcion_corta: Heartwarming life simulation with San-X characters.

descripcion_corta: 3D spatial awareness and geometry training tool.

descripcion_corta: Quirky Japanese mini-games based on the popular anime.

objetivo: Move through the shifting maze to collect all your treasures.
descripcion_corta: Authentic Ravensburger maze strategy game.
descripcion_larga: Experience the official Ravensburger Labyrinth on your DS. Navigate a constantly changing maze by strategically shifting corridors to reach your objectives first in this high-quality digital adaptation of the world-famous strategy game.

descripcion_larga: Journey through outer space in Magical Starsign (USA). Use the touch screen for strategic combat and spell casting, manage a team of diverse mages, and experience one of the most visually unique RPGs on the Nintendo DS.

gameplay: Fantasy adventure with creature care and puzzles.
objetivo: Help the unicorn regain its magic and save the forest.
descripcion_corta: Mythical creature simulation and adventure.
descripcion_larga: The Magical Unicorn is a gentle game for younger audiences. Care for your unicorn, solve simple puzzles, and explore a magical forest to restore peace to the kingdom in this localized European release for French, German, and Dutch speakers.

nombre: Magical Vacation - Itsutsu no Hoshi ga Narabu Toki (Japan)
gameplay: Turn-based RPG with elemental magic and socializing.
objetivo: Travel across five stars to save your magic academy.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese prequel to Magical Starsign.
descripcion_larga: Magical Vacation: Itsutsu no Hoshi ga Narabu Toki is a classic Brownie Brown RPG. With its signature hand-drawn art style and deep elemental magic system, it offers a grand adventure where your bonds with other students dictate your success in battle.

gameplay: Quiz and brain game based on the Japanese TV show.
objetivo: Win high-stakes quizzes using logic and quick thinking.
descripcion_corta: Popular Japanese game show adaptation for NDS.
descripcion_larga: Magical Zunou Power!! DS challenges your intellect with a variety of brain teasers and lateral thinking puzzles. Compete against the show's virtual contestants and prove you have the most powerful brain in this entertaining Japanese title.

gameplay: Life simulation and RPG with magic and school life.
objetivo: Become a master wizard while managing a magical town.
descripcion_corta: Magical school life sim (Animal Crossing with magic).
descripcion_larga: Magician's Quest: Mysterious Times is a deep simulation where you attend classes, catch bugs, fish, and build relationships. Every week brings a "Mystery Time" event where you must use your spells to solve supernatural occurrences in this US release.

gameplay: Puzzle and logic challenge with a colorful aesthetic.
objetivo: Solve a series of "MagicQ" themed puzzles to win.
descripcion_corta: Korean logic puzzle and trivia collection.
descripcion_larga: MagicQ DS is an engaging collection of brain games aimed at Korean players. It features a mix of memory tests, math puzzles, and logic challenges designed to be played in short bursts, making it a perfect "brain snack" for the handheld.

gameplay: Digital board game based on the award-winning toy.
objetivo: Find the hidden symbols in the labyrinth using magnets.
descripcion_corta: German digital adaptation of "The Magic Labyrinth."
descripcion_larga: Magische Labyrinth, Das brings the innovative board game to the DS. Use your memory to navigate invisible walls and collect magical tokens, offering a unique strategic experience for families and fans of the physical board game.

gameplay: Action-puzzle game involving magnets and marble chains.
objetivo: Prevent the marble chain from reaching the center hole.
descripcion_corta: Fast-paced magnetic puzzle action (Puzz Loop).
descripcion_larga: Magnetica is a high-energy puzzle game that uses the DS stylus to "flick" marbles. Use magnetic attraction and repulsion to create matches and clear the board in this addictive and stylish title, also known as Actionloop in other regions.

gameplay: Mahjong solitaire with an adventure storyline.
objetivo: Travel the world and restore the stolen treasures.
descripcion_corta: Adventure-themed Mahjong solitaire puzzle.
descripcion_larga: Mah Jong Quest: Expeditions (Europe) blends the classic tile-matching game with an epic quest. Solve hundreds of layouts across different continents, each with unique power-ups and challenges, to save the world of Mahjong from eternal darkness.

gameplay: Mahjong solitaire with an adventure storyline.
objetivo: Travel the world and restore the stolen treasures.
descripcion_corta: Multi-language European version of Mah Jong Quest.
descripcion_larga: This version of Mah Jong Quest offers the same addictive tile-matching gameplay with support for English, French, and Dutch. Master the "Quests" mode or relax with "Free Play" in this comprehensive digital Mahjong experience.

gameplay: Mahjong solitaire with an adventure storyline.
objetivo: Travel the world and restore the stolen treasures.
descripcion_corta: US release of the Mahjong puzzle adventure.
descripcion_larga: Embark on a journey of logic and wisdom in Mah Jong Quest: Expeditions (USA). This title features cinematic storytelling, over 90 layouts, and three different ways to play, making it the definitive Mahjong experience for North American puzzle fans.

nombre: Mahjong - Eine Reise um die Welt (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
gameplay: Mahjong tile-matching with a global travel theme.
objetivo: Match tiles to "travel" through famous world cities.
descripcion_corta: Educational Mahjong puzzle game for Europe.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong: Eine Reise um die Welt (A Trip Around the World) combines traditional puzzle gameplay with interesting facts about global landmarks. Clear boards to unlock new destinations in this relaxing and culturally enriched European title.

objetivo: Clear all tiles from the board within the time limit.
descripcion_corta: Standard Mahjong solitaire for the European market.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong (Europe) provides a clean and accessible digital version of the classic game. With multiple tile sets and dozens of layouts, it offers endless hours of relaxing gameplay for players looking for a portable mental challenge.

gameplay: Classic Mahjong tile-matching with German localization.
objetivo: Solve complex tile layouts and beat high scores.
descripcion_corta: German-exclusive edition of the Mahjong classic.
descripcion_larga: This localized German version of Mahjong features refined controls and a variety of difficulty settings. It focuses on the core Mahjong experience, providing a high-quality puzzle game for German-speaking fans of the genre.

nombre: Mahjong Fight Club DS - Wi-Fi Taiou (Japan)
gameplay: Competitive online Mahjong with official pro rules.
objetivo: Climb the ranks and become a Mahjong Master.
descripcion_corta: Konami's professional Mahjong battle game.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong Fight Club DS is the definitive competitive Mahjong experience. Featuring Wi-Fi support, you can play against real opponents across Japan, following the official rules of the Japan Professional Mahjong Federation in this high-stakes title.

nombre: Mahjong Fight Club DS - Wi-Fi Taiou (Japan) (Rev 1)
gameplay: Competitive online Mahjong with official pro rules.
objetivo: Climb the ranks and become a Mahjong Master.
descripcion_corta: Revised version of the professional Mahjong sim.
descripcion_larga: This Revision 1 of Mahjong Fight Club DS features improved Wi-Fi stability and minor bug fixes. It continues to offer the same deep, professional-grade Mahjong gameplay that has made the franchise a staple in Japanese arcades.

gameplay: Strategy Mahjong with a competitive "ranking" system.
objetivo: Win matches to earn "Dan" and "Kyuu" ranks.
descripcion_corta: High-quality Mahjong simulation and ranking battle.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong Haou DS: Dan-Kyuu Battle focuses on the competitive ladder of Mahjong. Play against challenging AI opponents to prove your skill and climb the professional ranking system in this feature-rich Japanese simulation.

gameplay: Enhanced Mahjong simulation with extra modes.
objetivo: Master the game of Mahjong and win tournaments.
descripcion_corta: Special edition of the Mahjong Haou series.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong Haou DS Special includes additional features and refined AI compared to previous entries. It offers a comprehensive tutorial for beginners and a grueling "Tournament Mode" for veterans, making it one of the most complete Mahjong titles in Japan.

gameplay: Tile-matching puzzle with an archaeological theme.
objetivo: Solve Mahjong puzzles to uncover the secrets of the Mayan city of Tikal.
descripcion_corta: Archaeological Mahjong adventure in ancient ruins.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong Journey: Quest for Tikal takes the classic solitaire gameplay to the heart of the jungle. Explore the mysteries of the Mayan civilization across five game modes and dozens of levels, featuring power-ups and stunning visual themes.

gameplay: Educational Mahjong guide and rulebook simulation.
objetivo: Learn the complex rules of Japanese Riichi Mahjong.
descripcion_corta: Comprehensive tutorial and guide for Mahjong.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong Navi DS is the ultimate assistant for Mahjong players. Whether you are a beginner or looking to refine your scoring (Fu and Han), this Japanese tool provides real-time calculations, rule explanations, and practice scenarios.

gameplay: Traditional table-top simulation with historic themes.
objetivo: Compete against historical Japanese figures in Mahjong.
descripcion_corta: Koei's classic Mahjong simulation series.
descripcion_larga: Mahjong Taikai brings the strategic board game to life with a unique historical twist. Face off against famous personalities from Japanese history in a realistic AI environment, featuring various tournament modes and detailed rule customization.

objetivo: Clear the board while exploring the myths of ancient Egypt.
descripcion_corta: Egyptian-themed Mahjong puzzle collection.
descripcion_larga: Mahjongg: Ancient Egypt blends classic logic gameplay with atmospheric desert visuals. Match hieroglyphic-themed tiles through challenging layouts while learning about the pharaohs and the gods of the Nile in this relaxing puzzle title.

objetivo: Match tiles to unlock the treasures of the Maya civilization.
descripcion_corta: Central American themed Mahjong solitaire.
descripcion_larga: Mahjongg: Ancient Mayas offers an exotic take on the tile-matching genre. Navigate through lush jungle backgrounds and stone-carved tile sets, featuring multiple game modes and an expansive campaign across the ancient Mayan empire.

objetivo: Match tiles to unlock the treasures of the Maya civilization.
descripcion_corta: Multi-language European edition of Ancient Mayas.
descripcion_larga: This version of Mahjongg: Ancient Mayas provides localized text for French, German, Spanish, and Italian players. It features the same addictive logic gameplay with high-quality visual assets and a focus on Mayan mythology and architecture.

objetivo: Solve hundreds of tile layouts in various difficulty levels.
descripcion_corta: Essential Mahjong solitaire for the Nintendo DS.
descripcion_larga: Mahjongg DS provides a sleek and straightforward puzzle experience. With a wide variety of tile sets, customizable backgrounds, and an intuitive touch-screen interface, it's the perfect companion for fans of traditional logic games.

objetivo: Help Giselle navigate New York City and return home.
descripcion_corta: Magical Disney adventure based on the hit movie.
descripcion_larga: Mahou ni Kakerarete (Enchanted) brings the whimsical world of Disney to the DS. Switch between the 2D animated realm and 3D New York, playing through mini-games and platforming levels that follow the story of the film.

nombre: Mainichi ga Tanoshii! - Ayanokouji Kimimaro no Happy Techou (Japan)
objetivo: Manage your daily schedule with a famous comedian's wit.
descripcion_corta: Hello Kitty-style lifestyle kit featuring Ayanokouji Kimimaro.
descripcion_larga: Mainichi ga Tanoshii! features the humor of famous comedian Ayanokouji Kimimaro. This digital organizer includes a diary, calendar, and health tracking tools, all peppered with audio clips and jokes to brighten your daily routine.

nombre: Mainichi Kokorobics - Kaiun Kenkyuuka Utsukita Mahiro Kanshuu - DS Uranai Happiness 2008 (Japan)
objetivo: Check your daily luck and follow advice for a better 2008.
descripcion_corta: Personal zodiac and fortune-telling simulation.
descripcion_larga: Mainichi Kokorobics is a lifestyle tool focused on luck and wellness for 2008. Supervised by Mahiro Utsukita, it offers daily horoscopes, feng shui tips, and personality tests to help Japanese players improve their spiritual happiness.

nombre: Mainichi Shinbun Soukan 135 Shuunen Project - Mainichi Shinbun 1000 Dai News (Japan)
gameplay: News archive and history trivia collection.
objetivo: Study 135 years of global news events from the Mainichi Shimbun.
descripcion_corta: Digital newspaper archive and news trivia.
descripcion_larga: This project celebrates the 135th anniversary of the Mainichi Shimbun. It serves as a digital encyclopedia of over 1,000 major news stories, complete with quizzes and historical photos to educate players on Japanese and world history.

nombre: Mainichi Shinbunsha Kyouryoku - Saikyou no Kanji Drill 5-man Mon (Japan)
gameplay: Educational Kanji practice and drill software.
objetivo: Master over 50,000 Kanji problems through repetitive practice.
descripcion_corta: High-intensity Kanji training for Japanese speakers.
descripcion_larga: This collaboration with Mainichi Shinbunsha provides a massive database for Kanji learning. From school-level basics to advanced calligraphy, use the stylus to write and recognize characters across thousands of interactive drills.

nombre: Mainichi Suteki! - Hello Kitty no Life Kit (Japan)
gameplay: Lifestyle utility and digital organizer with Hello Kitty.
objetivo: Organize your life using Sanrio's most famous character.
descripcion_corta: Hello Kitty themed lifestyle and productivity tool.
descripcion_larga: Mainichi Suteki! Hello Kitty no Life Kit turns your DS into a multifunctional organizer. It features a digital planner, calorie counter, and period tracker, all decorated with adorable Hello Kitty motifs and customizable themes.

nombre: Mais Ou Se Cache Carmen Sandiego - Mystere au Bout du Monde (Europe) (En,Fr)
objetivo: Track down the elusive thief Carmen Sandiego across the globe.
descripcion_corta: Geography-based detective mystery for NDS.
descripcion_larga: Mais Ou Se Cache Carmen Sandiego (Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?) tasks you with solving international crimes. Use your knowledge of geography and history to follow clues and catch the world's most famous thief.

nombre: Maji de Manabu - LEC de Ukaru - DS Hisho Kentei 2-kyuu - 3-kyuu (Japan)
gameplay: Educational study aid for secretarial certification.
objetivo: Pass the Level 2 and 3 Secretarial Exams through mock tests.
descripcion_corta: Official LEC study guide for secretarial skills.
descripcion_larga: Maji de Manabu: DS Hisho Kentei is a comprehensive training tool for the Japanese Secretarial Proficiency Test. It includes thousands of practice questions and interactive lessons on business etiquette and administrative tasks.

nombre: Maji de Manabu - LEC de Ukaru - DS Kikenbutsu Toriatsukaisha Otsushu 4 Rui (Japan)
gameplay: Educational study aid for hazardous materials handling.
objetivo: Prepare for the Category 4 Hazardous Materials Operator exam.
descripcion_corta: Specialized vocational training for industrial safety.
descripcion_larga: This LEC training tool focuses on the Otsushu 4 Rui certification. It provides structured study plans and simulated exams to help Japanese users master the safety protocols required for handling flammable liquids and chemicals.

nombre: Maji de Manabu - LEC de Ukaru - DS Koumuin Shiken - Suuteki Shori (Japan)
gameplay: Educational study aid for the Civil Service exam.
objetivo: Master "Numerical Processing" logic for government entrance.
descripcion_corta: Advanced logic and math trainer for civil servants.
descripcion_larga: Maji de Manabu: DS Koumuin Shiken targets the difficult numerical reasoning section of the Japanese civil service exam. It offers step-by-step logic solutions and timed tests to build speed and accuracy for job seekers.

nombre: Maji de Manabu - LEC de Ukaru - DS Nisshou Boki 3-kyuu (Japan)
gameplay: Educational study aid for bookkeeping certification.
objetivo: Learn Level 3 Nisshou Boki accounting and bookkeeping.
descripcion_corta: Financial accounting and bookkeeping study tool.
descripcion_larga: This title provides a structured curriculum for the Nisshou Boki Level 3 exam. Use the stylus to solve balance sheets and ledger entries, featuring audio explanations and progress tracking for aspiring Japanese accountants.

nombre: Maji de Manabu - LEC de Ukaru - DS Takuchi Tatemono Torihiki Shuninsha - 2011 Nen & 2012 Nendo Ban (Japan)
gameplay: Educational study aid for real estate certification.
objetivo: Study for the 2011/2012 Real Estate Broker exams.
descripcion_corta: Specialized legal training for Japanese real estate.
descripcion_larga: Maji de Manabu: DS Takuchi Tatemono focuses on the "Takken" exam. It features updated laws and practice questions for the 2011/2012 period, helping users navigate complex property laws and transaction regulations.

nombre: Maji de Manabu - LEC de Ukaru - DS Takuchi Tatemono Torihiki Shuninsha (Japan)
gameplay: Educational study aid for real estate certification.
objetivo: Learn the fundamentals of real estate brokerage and laws.
descripcion_corta: Professional certification trainer for real estate brokers.
descripcion_larga: This LEC series entry helps students prepare for the Real Estate Transaction Specialist exam. It features a massive database of past exam questions and interactive flashcards to ensure a deep understanding of Japanese housing laws.

nombre: Majime ni Fumajime - Kaiketsu Zorori - Kyoufu no Takarabako (Japan)
gameplay: Side-scrolling action-adventure based on the anime.
objetivo: Help Zorori find the legendary treasure and evade traps.
descripcion_corta: Humorous action-adventure based on the popular manga.
descripcion_larga: Majime ni Fumajime follows the mischievous fox Zorori in a quest for a mysterious treasure box. Solve environmental puzzles and engage in platforming action across levels that capture the humor and art style of the beloved series.

nombre: Majin Tantei Nougami Neuro - Neuro to Yako no Bishoku Zanmai - Suiri Tsuki - Gourmet & Mystery (Japan)
objetivo: Solve supernatural crimes while satisfying Neuro's hunger.
descripcion_corta: Mystery-adventure based on the hit manga.
descripcion_larga: Majin Tantei Nougami Neuro blends detective work with high-stakes interrogation. Use Yako's gourmet knowledge and Neuro's demonic powers to solve murders through interactive "Gourmet & Mystery" gameplay and deduction puzzles.

objetivo: Train to become a full-fledged witch through various trials.
descripcion_corta: Witchcraft-themed RPG with social elements.
descripcion_larga: Majo ni Naru (Becoming a Witch) is a charming adventure where you learn spells and interact with townspeople. Balance your magical studies with daily tasks and explore a hand-drawn world as you grow from a novice into a powerful witch.

gameplay: Sports simulation based on the "Major" anime.
objetivo: Lead Goro Honda and his team to the high school championship.
descripcion_corta: High-stakes baseball drama based on the hit manga.
descripcion_larga: Major DS: Dream Baseball brings the intense baseball action of the series to the DS. Use the touch screen to pitch and hit, relive iconic moments from the story, and manage your team’s roster to win the dream title.

gameplay: Realistic baseball simulation with updated rosters.
objetivo: Win the World Series through strategic management and play.
descripcion_corta: The 2010 edition of 2K Sports' baseball franchise.
descripcion_larga: Major League Baseball 2K10 features a refined "Total Control" pitching and hitting system. With the most accurate rosters of the season and a deep Franchise mode, it's the definitive portable baseball experience for MLB fans.

gameplay: Realistic baseball simulation with official licenses.
objetivo: Take your favorite team to the top of the standings.
descripcion_corta: The first 2K baseball title for the Nintendo DS.
descripcion_larga: Major League Baseball 2K7 provides an authentic MLB experience. Use the dual screens to manage your fielding and batting, featuring real players, stadiums, and an intuitive control scheme that brings the big leagues to your pocket.

gameplay: Stylized arcade baseball with power-ups and fantasy elements.
objetivo: Win the championship with super-powered versions of MLB stars.
descripcion_corta: Over-the-top arcade baseball with stylized graphics.
descripcion_larga: MLB 2K8: Fantasy All-Stars trades realism for fun. Execute "power swings" and "fire balls" in stylized stadiums, featuring caricatured versions of real MLB pros and accessible, fast-paced gameplay for casual sports fans.

gameplay: Stylized arcade baseball with power-ups and fantasy elements.
objetivo: Outplay your rivals using special abilities and power-ups.
descripcion_corta: The fantasy-focused sequel to MLB 2K8.
descripcion_larga: Major League Baseball 2K9: Fantasy All-Stars returns with even more power-ups and bizarre stadiums. Choose your All-Star team and use the touch screen to activate game-changing abilities in this high-energy, non-traditional baseball sim.

nombre: Makai Senki Disgaea - Makai no Ouji to Akai Tsuki (Japan)
gameplay: Tactical RPG with grid-based combat and monster recruitment.
objetivo: Help Prince Laharl reclaim his throne in the Netherworld.
descripcion_corta: Port of the legendary strategy RPG Disgaea.
descripcion_larga: Makai Senki Disgaea (Disgaea DS) brings the "million points of damage" series to the handheld. Featuring a dual-screen layout for better battlefield overview, recruit monsters, use the Geo Effect system, and grind to level 9999 in this epic RPG.

gameplay: Mathematical puzzle game based on the number 10.
objetivo: Solve various arithmetic puzzles where the goal is always 10.
descripcion_corta: Innovative and fun math-based puzzle quest.
descripcion_larga: Make 10: A Journey of Numbers is a whimsical puzzle game from Nintendo. Explore a strange world and talk to "Number Pixies" while solving touch-screen math drills that require you to add numbers up to 10 in clever ways.

objetivo: Master the art of makeup and styling to win competitions.
descripcion_corta: Korean localized version of the makeup sim.
descripcion_larga: Make-up Paradise allows players to experiment with countless beauty products. Use the stylus to apply eyeshadow, lipstick, and blush, managing a salon and helping clients find their perfect look for various social events.

objetivo: Help the princess look her best for the royal ball.
descripcion_corta: Korean beauty and fashion simulation for young girls.
descripcion_larga: Makeup Princess focuses on the royal aesthetic. Choose from elegant gowns, sparkling jewelry, and a wide array of cosmetics to transform your character into a stunning princess, featuring creative touch-screen gameplay and vibrant art.

nombre: Malediction de Toutankhamon, La - Enigmes & Objets Caches (France)
objetivo: Break the curse of King Tutankhamun by finding hidden relics.
descripcion_corta: Egyptian-themed hidden object mystery in French.
descripcion_larga: La Malédiction de Toutankhamon (France) sumerge a los jugadores en una investigación arqueológica. Encuentra objetos ocultos en escenarios detallados del antiguo Egipto, resuelve acertijos de lógica y desvela los secretos del faraón en este título de misterio para NDS.

gameplay: Brain training exercises and logic puzzles.
objetivo: Improve cognitive speed and memory with colorful mini-games.
descripcion_corta: Korean version of Big Brain Academy.
descripcion_larga: Mallangmallang Dunoegyosil es la versión coreana del popular Big Brain Academy. Desafía tu mente en cinco categorías diferentes: lógica, memoria, análisis, cálculo y formas, ideal para jugadores de todas las edades que buscan agilidad mental rápida.

gameplay: Virtual pet simulation with a baby seal.
objetivo: Care for a cute Mamegoma seal and keep a daily diary.
descripcion_corta: Adorable baby seal raising simulation.
descripcion_larga: Mamegoma: Honobono Nikki te permite adoptar a una de las famosas focas bebé de San-X. Aliméntala, báñala y juega con ella mientras registras su crecimiento en un diario virtual lleno de ternura y estética kawaii japonesa.

nombre: Mamegoma 2 - Uchi no Ko ga Ichiban! (Japan)
gameplay: Virtual pet simulation with breeding and contests.
objetivo: Raise the best Mamegoma seal and win local competitions.
descripcion_corta: The second installment of the cute seal series.
descripcion_larga: Mamegoma 2: Uchi no Ko ga Ichiban! mejora la experiencia de crianza con más tipos de focas y accesorios. Participa en concursos de belleza y talento, y utiliza la pantalla táctil para acariciar y entrenar a tu mascota favorita en este éxito japonés.

gameplay: Virtual pet simulation with expanded customization.
objetivo: Collect all varieties of Mamegoma and decorate their habitat.
descripcion_corta: The third and most complete Mamegoma pet sim.
descripcion_larga: Mamegoma 3: Kawaii ga Ippai! ofrece una cantidad masiva de objetos de personalización. Disfruta de nuevos mini-juegos y una interacción más profunda con las focas en un entorno relajante, perfecto para los fans del coleccionismo y lo adorable.

gameplay: Educational financial simulation and FX trading.
objetivo: Learn the basics of Forex trading and manage virtual capital.
descripcion_corta: Forex trading trainer for Japanese users.
descripcion_larga: Manepa 1000 Mannin no FX Training es una herramienta educativa sobre el mercado de divisas. Practica estrategias de inversión en tiempo real con datos simulados, aprende terminología financiera y mejora tus habilidades de trading sin riesgo de perder dinero real.

nombre: Manga-ka Debut Monogatari DS - Akogare! Manga-ka Ikusei Game (Japan)
objetivo: Rise from a novice artist to a professional Manga-ka.
descripcion_corta: Manga creator career simulation and training.
descripcion_larga: Manga-ka Debut Monogatari DS te pone en la piel de un dibujante de cómics. Gestiona tu tiempo entre dibujar páginas, reunirte con editores y mejorar tus habilidades artísticas usando el lápiz táctil como si fuera una pluma profesional.

nombre: Manga-ka Debut Monogatari DS - Akogare! Manga-ka Ikusei Game (Japan) (Rev 1)
objetivo: Rise from a novice artist to a professional Manga-ka.
descripcion_corta: Revised version of the manga creator simulation.
descripcion_larga: Esta Rev 1 de Manga-ka Debut Monogatari DS incluye ajustes de jugabilidad y correcciones menores. Sigue el camino del éxito en la industria del manga japonés, equilibrando tu vida social con el duro trabajo de entregar capítulos a tiempo.

gameplay: High-speed micro-games using touch and mic controls.
objetivo: Complete hundreds of 5-second tasks to defeat the boss.
descripcion_corta: Korean version of WarioWare Touched!
descripcion_larga: Manjyeora: Made in Wario es la divertidísima versión coreana de WarioWare. Usa el stylus para picar, frotar y arrastrar en una serie frenética de micro-juegos absurdos que aprovechan al máximo todas las funciones de la Nintendo DS.

gameplay: Side-scrolling action RPG with character classes.
objetivo: Explore the Maple World and defeat the Dark Mage.
descripcion_corta: Portable adaptation of the popular Korean MMORPG.
descripcion_larga: MapleStory DS traslada la magia del RPG online a una aventura de un solo jugador. Elige entre cuatro clases únicas, sube de nivel, recolecta equipo y vive una historia épica con el estilo artístico vibrante que caracteriza a esta franquicia coreana.

objetivo: Lead a group of penguins safely through icy obstacles.
descripcion_corta: Puzzle adventure based on the award-winning documentary.
descripcion_larga: March of the Penguins (Europe) te reta a guiar a las colonias de pingüinos emperador. Usa el entorno para protegerlos de depredadores y el clima extremo en una serie de niveles de lógica que requieren planificación y reflejos.

objetivo: Lead a group of penguins safely through icy obstacles.
descripcion_corta: US release of the penguin-themed puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Follow the epic journey of the Emperor penguins in March of the Penguins (USA). Navigate through 12 levels based on the film, using the DS stylus to build bridges or clear paths to ensure the survival of the flock.

gameplay: Puzzle collection featuring multiple logic games.
objetivo: Solve diverse puzzles to unlock high scores and achievements.
descripcion_corta: Compilation of brain teasers and logic puzzles.
descripcion_larga: Margot's Bepuzzled! ofrece una variedad de juegos clásicos como Sudoku, crucigramas y rompecabezas de palabras. Ideal para sesiones de juego cortas, este título europeo pone a prueba tu agilidad mental con una interfaz limpia y accesible.

gameplay: Word-based puzzle game with multiple modes.
objetivo: Solve word searches and anagrams to boost your vocabulary.
descripcion_corta: Challenging word game collection for Europe.
descripcion_larga: Margot's Word Brain es el desafío definitivo para los amantes de las letras. Incluye seis modos de juego diferentes que pondrán a prueba tu capacidad de deletreo y asociación de palabras bajo presión de tiempo en varios idiomas europeos.

gameplay: Word-based puzzle game with multiple modes.
objetivo: Solve word searches and anagrams to boost your vocabulary.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the word puzzle trainer.
descripcion_larga: Test your vocabulary with Margot's Word Brain (USA). Use the touch screen to find hidden words and solve complex linguistic puzzles. Es una herramienta excelente tanto para entretenerse como para mejorar el vocabulario y la velocidad mental.

gameplay: Educational mini-games with a science theme.
objetivo: Learn scientific principles through experiments and quizzes.

objetivo: Experience all four Mega Man Zero adventures in one cart.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Zero saga collection.

descripcion_corta: The acclaimed sequel to the original ZX.

descripcion_corta: Zoo simulation focused on baby animal care.

descripcion_larga: Mein Franzoesisch Coach provides a structured path to learning French. Featuring speech recognition and thousands of exercises, it helps German speakers master basic to intermediate French in a fun, interactive way on the NDS.

descripcion_corta: Pediatrician career simulation for younger players.

descripcion_corta: Educational English language coach for German speakers.

descripcion_corta: German language and vocabulary enhancement tool.
descripcion_larga: Mein Wortschatz-Coach (Rev 1) helps native speakers refine their German. It features challenging word games and logic puzzles designed to expand your expressive range and correct common grammatical errors in a portable format.

nombre: Meine Tierarztpraxis - Einsatz auf dem Land (Germany)

descripcion_corta: Classic pet vet simulation for German speakers.

descripcion_corta: Exotic vet simulation featuring kangaroos and koalas.

descripcion_corta: Comprehensive pet hotel simulation for Germany.

descripcion_corta: The feature-rich sequel to the pet hotel hit.

descripcion_larga: Moomin-dani no Okurimono is a relaxing exploration game. Follow Moomintroll and his friends through seasonal stories, solving gentle puzzles and enjoying the beautiful, storybook-style world of Tove Jansson's characters.

objetivo: Uncover the mystery of an abandoned lunar base.
descripcion_corta: Atmospheric FPS with a deep sci-fi narrative.
descripcion_larga: Moon (Europe) is a technical masterpiece for the DS. Experience smooth 60FPS gameplay as you explore the lunar surface and subterranean tunnels, using high-tech gadgets to solve puzzles and fight an alien threat.

objetivo: Uncover the mystery of an abandoned lunar base.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the acclaimed FPS Moon.
descripcion_larga: Dive into the silence of space in Moon (USA). This first-person adventure emphasizes exploration and atmosphere, featuring a gripping story about a hidden conspiracy on the lunar surface that will keep you on edge.

gameplay: Match-3 puzzle game with a treasure hunt theme.
objetivo: Match jewels to unlock the secrets of the dark ruins.
descripcion_corta: Addictive puzzle game featuring the Moorhuhn cast.
descripcion_larga: Moorhuhn: Jewel of Darkness (Europe) takes the famous chicken on a puzzle adventure. Clear ancient chambers by matching gems in this fast-paced logic title that rewards quick thinking and explosive combos.

gameplay: Kart racing with the Moorhuhn characters.
objetivo: Win races across cosmic tracks to become the star racer.
descripcion_corta: Galactic kart racing with quirky chicken characters.
descripcion_larga: Moorhuhn: Star Karts (Europe) brings the frantic fun of kart racing to space. Use power-ups, master the drifts, and outpace your feathered rivals in this colorful and accessible multi-language racer.

objetivo: Find the lost treasure of the Pharaoh in ancient Egypt.
descripcion_corta: Egyptian-themed adventure starring the Moorhuhn.
descripcion_larga: Moorhuhn Adventure: The Pharaoh's Treasure sends the iconic chicken on an archeological quest. Solve intricate puzzles and interact with funny characters to uncover a legendary treasure in this charming European title.

objetivo: Shoot the chickens and complete various score challenges.
descripcion_corta: The core Moorhuhn experience for Nintendo DS.
descripcion_larga: Moorhuhn DS brings the classic shooting gallery gameplay to the touch screen. Aim and tap to shoot the flying chickens and discover hidden bonuses in this simple yet highly addictive arcade-style collection.

objetivo: Guide Moorhuhn through the underwater city of Atlantis.
descripcion_corta: Platforming adventure set in the sunken city.
descripcion_larga: Moorhuhn Jump'n Run: Atlantis features challenging levels filled with traps and enemies. Collect treasures and navigate complex environments as you help the famous chicken explore the wonders of the deep.

nombre: More Brain Training from Dr Kawashima - How Old Is Your Brain (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)
objetivo: Keep your brain young with daily mental challenges.
descripcion_corta: The popular sequel to Dr. Kawashima's Brain Training.
descripcion_larga: More Brain Training (Europe) features all-new exercises like Rock-Paper-Scissors and Serial Subtraction. Use the touch screen and microphone to lower your "Brain Age" in this multi-language daily trainer.

objetivo: Complete new and challenging Mario levels.
descripcion_corta: Fan-made modification of New Super Mario Bros.
descripcion_larga: More Super Mario Bras. is a creative romhack that provides veteran players with a higher level of difficulty and redesigned stages, offering a fresh perspective on the classic DS platforming engine.

objetivo: Complete new and challenging Mario levels.
descripcion_corta: The second installment of the fan-made Mario hack.
descripcion_larga: Expanding on the first hack, More Super Mario Bras. 2 adds even more custom assets and complex level designs, pushing the player's platforming skills to the limit in this unofficial expansion.

nombre: More Super Mario Bros. Hack Domain Infusion
objetivo: Explore a "hacked" domain with unique Mario mechanics.
descripcion_corta: Advanced fan-made modification for Mario fans.
descripcion_larga: This "Hack Domain Infusion" version features experimental level design and technical tweaks, offering a unique and often surreal experience for fans of the New Super Mario Bros. homebrew scene.

gameplay: Multi-game collection of card and puzzle games.
objetivo: Master dozens of mini-games to earn high scores.
descripcion_corta: The second collection of the popular TouchMaster series.
descripcion_larga: More TouchMaster (Europe) brings another round of addictive arcade titles. From card games like Solitaire to fast-paced puzzle and action games, it's the perfect "pick-up-and-play" title for short sessions.

nombre: Mori no Cafeteria DS - Oshare na Cafe Recipe (Japan)
objetivo: Manage a stylish forest cafe and collect recipes.
descripcion_corta: Charming cafe management and cooking sim.
descripcion_larga: Mori no Cafeteria DS allows you to design your own cafe and serve forest animals. Learn stylish recipes, decorate your shop, and build a relaxing environment in this adorable Japanese simulation.

nombre: Morinaga Takurou Kanshuu - Okane no Shin Joushiki DS Training (Japan)
objetivo: Learn "new common sense" about money and economics.
descripcion_corta: Educational tool for personal finance and economy.
descripcion_larga: Managed by economist Takurou Morinaga, this title teaches Japanese players about savings, investment, and economic history through interactive quizzes and daily financial drills for the NDS.

objetivo: Plan the perfect celebration for various life events.
descripcion_corta: Unique simulation focused on anniversaries and gifts.
descripcion_larga: Moshimo! Kinen Surunara... is a specialized planner and sim. Learn the etiquette for weddings, birthdays, and holidays in Japan, managing budgets and choosing gifts to create the perfect commemorative event.

objetivo: Serve as a juror and determine the verdict in various cases.
descripcion_corta: Realistic lay judge (Saiban-in) system simulator.
descripcion_larga: Moshimo! Saibanin ni Erabaretara... prepares players for the Japanese jury system. Listen to testimonies, analyze evidence, and deliberate with other jurors to reach a fair verdict in this educational drama.

nombre: Moto Racer DS - Moto GP, Traffic, Super Cross, Freestyle (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Compete in Moto GP, Super Cross, and Freestyle events.
descripcion_corta: Comprehensive motorcycle racing game for Europe.
descripcion_larga: Moto Racer DS offers four distinct racing styles in one package. Master the tight corners of Moto GP or the stunts of Freestyle, featuring a deep career mode and local wireless multiplayer for up to 8 players.

objetivo: Solve hundreds of crossword grids using the stylus.
descripcion_corta: Portable French crossword collection.
descripcion_larga: Mots Croises provides a clean and intuitive interface for crossword fans. With various difficulty levels and a huge database of words, it's a great way to improve your French vocabulary and keep your mind sharp.

objetivo: Solve an expanded collection of crossword grids.
descripcion_corta: The second volume of the French crossword series.
descripcion_larga: Mots Croises 2 (France) adds even more puzzles and improved handwriting recognition. It's the perfect sequel for word game enthusiasts looking for a portable and challenging mental workout on the go.

nombre: Motto Hayaku! Seikaku ni! - Kazu Sense, Keisanryoku Up Training - Suutore (Japan)
gameplay: Arithmetic drills and mental math training.
objetivo: Improve calculation speed and "number sense" (Kazu Sense).
descripcion_corta: Fast-paced math and calculation trainer for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Motto Hayaku! Seikaku ni! focuses on precision and speed. It offers a series of daily mathematical challenges designed to sharpen the user's mental arithmetic and logical thinking through repetitive, timed exercises.

nombre: Motto Me de Unou o Kitaeru - DS Sokudoku Jutsu (Japan)
objetivo: Master advanced speed-reading techniques.
descripcion_corta: Advanced speed-reading and right-brain trainer.
descripcion_larga: Motto Me de Unou o Kitaeru is the sequel to the popular speed-reading tool. It features new methods to increase reading comprehension and visual processing speed, helping users consume information faster and more effectively.

objetivo: Prepare for the TOEIC exam with mock tests and drills.
descripcion_corta: Specialized TOEIC test preparation tool for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Motto TOEIC Test DS Training offers a comprehensive curriculum for the Test of English for International Communication. It includes thousands of practice questions, listening exercises, and a vocabulary builder for Japanese professionals.

nombre: Motto! Stitch! DS - Rhythm de Rakugaki Daisakusen (Japan)
objetivo: Follow the rhythm to draw and paint with Stitch.
descripcion_corta: Disney-themed rhythm and creativity game for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Motto! Stitch! DS combines music and art. Use the stylus to follow rhythmic prompts and create "rakugaki" (doodles) while interacting with characters from the popular Lilo & Stitch series in a vibrant Japanese setting.

nombre: Motto! Stitch! DS - Rhythm de Rakugaki Daisakusen (Japan) [T-En by PrayashLand v0.5.1]
objetivo: Follow the rhythm to draw and paint with Stitch.
descripcion_corta: English fan-translated version of the Stitch rhythm game.
descripcion_larga: Motto! Stitch! DS [T-En] allows English-speaking fans to enjoy this rhythmic adventure. Master the beat-based drawing challenges and follow the charming story of Stitch's antics in Japan with fully translated menus and dialogue.

gameplay: Puzzle and logic game with a mouse theme.
objetivo: Guide the mouse through mazes to find the cheese.
descripcion_corta: Casual logic and maze navigation puzzle.
descripcion_larga: Mouse DS (Europe) is a family-friendly puzzle game. Use the touch screen to manipulate environmental elements and clear a path for the hungry mouse, featuring dozens of levels that test your spatial reasoning.

objetivo: Study and collect microbes while managing a farm.
descripcion_corta: Unique agricultural simulation based on the anime.
descripcion_larga: Moyashimon DS: Tales of Agriculture brings the world of microscopic fungi to life. Interact with cute microbes, manage a fermentation lab, and explore the agricultural university in this quirky and educational Japanese title.

objetivo: Help Mr. Bean through a series of comedic mishaps.
descripcion_corta: Humorous mini-game collection based on the TV show.
descripcion_larga: Mr Bean (Europe) captures the slapstick humor of Rowan Atkinson’s character. Complete a variety of wacky tasks and puzzles across diverse locations, using the stylus for interactive physical comedy on the go.

objetivo: Drill deep into the earth while managing oxygen levels.
descripcion_corta: Classic arcade-style digging and puzzle action.
descripcion_larga: Mr. Driller: Drill Spirits (Europe) brings the intense puzzle series to the dual screen. Dig through colored blocks to reach the goal, collect air capsules, and unlock new characters in this addictive high-stakes arcade game.

objetivo: Drill deep into the earth while managing oxygen levels.
descripcion_corta: Japanese release of the frantic Driller puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Experience the original Japanese version of Mr. Driller: Drill Spirits. Featuring competitive multiplayer and several distinct game modes, it challenges your reflexes and planning as you dig through crumbling subterranean layers.

objetivo: Drill deep into the earth while managing oxygen levels.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the classic digging hit.
descripcion_larga: Dig for your life in Mr. Driller: Drill Spirits (USA). This version utilizes the DS dual screens to show the depth of your descent, offering a pulse-pounding experience where every block you break could lead to victory or a crushing defeat.

objetivo: Defeat the Underminer and save the city as the Incredibles.
descripcion_corta: Action-packed sequel to The Incredibles movie.
descripcion_larga: Mr. Incredible - Kyouteki Underminer Toujou (Japan) allows players to control Mr. Incredible and Frozone. Fight through robot armies and solve environmental puzzles to stop a subterranean threat in this high-energy movie tie-in.

objetivo: Stretch and anchor Mr. Slime's limbs to reach the goal.
descripcion_corta: Innovative stylus-based action-adventure.
descripcion_larga: Mr. Slime Jr. (Europe) features a unique "grab and pull" mechanic. Use the stylus to manipulate the character's elastic arms, swinging through levels and avoiding hazards in a world governed by fun and stretchy physics.

objetivo: Stretch and anchor Mr. Slime's limbs to reach the goal.
descripcion_corta: German localized edition of the physics platformer.
descripcion_larga: Guide the bouncy protagonist through challenging environments in Mr. Slime Jr. (Germany). Master the unique touch-screen controls to navigate vertical mazes and overcome enemies in this creative handheld title.

objetivo: Prove you are the ultimate fan in various music challenges.
descripcion_corta: MTV-licensed trivia and music fan simulation.
descripcion_larga: MTV Fan Attack (Europe) tests your knowledge of pop culture and music history. Complete mini-games, answer difficult trivia, and manage your "fandom" to climb the ranks of music super-fans in this stylish NDS title.

objetivo: Prove you are the ultimate fan in various music challenges.
descripcion_corta: Northern European/Benelux edition of the MTV game.
descripcion_larga: This regional version of MTV Fan Attack provides localized content for fans in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and the Netherlands. Show off your music expertise and conquer the leaderboards in this multi-language trivia experience.

objetivo: Command a fleet and explore the galaxy to find the "Flux."
descripcion_corta: Epic sci-fi space opera RPG for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: Mugen Kouro (Infinite Space) is a deep simulation RPG. Customize dozens of starships, manage a massive crew, and engage in tactical fleet battles while uncovering a sprawling narrative that spans years and galaxies.

nombre: Mugen no Frontier - Super Robot Taisen OG Saga (Japan)
objetivo: Lead a team of heroes across different dimensions.
descripcion_corta: High-octane RPG crossover from the Super Robot series.
descripcion_larga: Mugen no Frontier: Super Robot Taisen OG Saga features a unique real-time combo battle system. Control Haken Browning and his allies in a world blending sci-fi and fantasy, featuring dynamic animations and fanservice-heavy combat.

nombre: Mugen no Frontier Exceed - Super Robot Taisen OG Saga (Japan)
objetivo: Fight through the "Multiverse" and stop a new threat.
descripcion_corta: The expanded and refined sequel to Mugen no Frontier.
descripcion_larga: Mugen no Frontier Exceed offers even more characters, longer combos, and improved graphics. This Japanese RPG is known for its fast-paced, rhythmic combat system and deep crossover story involving multiple legendary franchises.

objetivo: Explore Moominvalley and solve the mystery of the cries.
descripcion_corta: Scandinavian adventure based on the Moomin series.
descripcion_larga: Mummi og de Mystiske Hylene (Northern Europe) is a charming story-based game for kids. Help Moomintroll and Sniff investigate strange noises in the valley through gentle puzzles and exploration in multiple Nordic languages.

objetivo: Prepare the valley for the Great Autumn Festival.
descripcion_corta: Seasonal Moomin adventure for Northern Europe.
descripcion_larga: Join the Moomins in their harvest preparations. This title features a variety of mini-games focused on coordination and simple logic, all wrapped in the beautiful and calming art style of the classic Moomin books.

nombre: Mummy, The - Tomb of the Dragon Emperor (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Find the Dragon Emperor and stop his terracotta army.
descripcion_corta: Action-adventure based on the third Mummy film.
descripcion_larga: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor (Europe) puts you in the shoes of Rick and Alex O'Connell. Use guns, torches, and hand-to-hand combat to fight through ancient Chinese tombs and snowy peaks in this movie tie-in.

nombre: Mummy, The - Tomb of the Dragon Emperor (USA) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Find the Dragon Emperor and stop his terracotta army.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the movie action game.
descripcion_larga: Experience the cinematic thrills in The Mummy (USA). Navigate dangerous ruins, solve environmental puzzles, and engage in epic boss battles against the immortal Emperor in this action-packed handheld adventure.

objetivo: Collect and train urban insects to win battles.
descripcion_corta: Suburban bug-collecting and training game for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Mushi: Machi no Konchuu Monogatari allows players to find various beetles and bugs in a Japanese town setting. Train your insects and compete in "Sumo" style matches, learning about real-life bug behavior along the way.

objetivo: Help the Mushishi Ginko solve mysterious "Mushi" cases.
descripcion_corta: Atmospheric adventure based on the Mushishi manga.
descripcion_larga: Mushishi: Ame Furu Sato is a visually stunning title that captures the zen-like mood of the series. Travel through rural Japan, gather information about supernatural occurrences, and solve puzzles to heal people affected by the Mushi.

nombre: Mushroom Men - Rise of the Fungi (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Lead the Mushroom Men to victory against the warring fungi.
descripcion_corta: Stylized and creative action-platformer.
descripcion_larga: Mushroom Men: Rise of the Fungi (Europe) features a unique perspective on a world of tiny combatants. Use household items to craft weapons and explore a giant-scale world from the viewpoint of a mushroom warrior.

nombre: Mushroom Men - Rise of the Fungi (USA) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Lead the Mushroom Men to victory against the warring fungi.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Mushroom Men saga.
descripcion_larga: Battle for survival in Mushroom Men (USA). Choose your character class, scavenge for parts to build powerful weapons, and fight through diverse environments in this imaginative prequel to the Wii version of the game.

gameplay: Music creation and digital instrument tool.
objetivo: Compose original music using a variety of digital tools.
descripcion_corta: Accessible music composition software for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: Music for Everyone (Europe) turns the handheld into a studio. It features easy-to-use interfaces for creating melodies and rhythms, designed for beginners who want to explore the basics of songwriting without complex equipment.

nombre: Music Monstars - The Ultimate Music Machine (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Form a band and rise to the top of the music charts.
descripcion_corta: Rhythmic adventure and pop-star simulation.
descripcion_larga: Music Monstars: The Ultimate Music Machine (Europe) combines touch-screen rhythm gameplay with career management. Choose your instruments, customize your band's look, and perform hits to win over the crowd in this musical quest.

nombre: Music Star - I Wanna Be a Popstar (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)
objetivo: Train your voice and perform to become a pop sensation.
descripcion_corta: Popstar career simulation for young music fans.
descripcion_larga: Music Star: I Wanna Be a Popstar (Europe) takes you through the life of a rising artist. Practice singing, master dance moves, and manage your social calendar to build a fan base and reach the top of the charts in this multi-language title.

objetivo: Win races and perform stunts across varied terrains.
descripcion_corta: High-speed motocross and ATV racing for Europe.
descripcion_larga: MX vs ATV Reflex (Europe) features the "Rider Reflex" system, allowing for independent control of the rider and vehicle. Navigate mud, snow, and dirt while performing gravity-defying tricks in this intense off-road sim.

objetivo: Win races and perform stunts across varied terrains.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the MX vs ATV hit.
descripcion_larga: Feel the dirt in MX vs ATV Reflex (USA). With a variety of vehicles including bikes and quads, this title offers realistic physics, a deep career mode, and frantic multiplayer races that emphasize skill and timing.

objetivo: Master the extreme limits of motocross and ATV racing.
descripcion_corta: French edition of the MX vs ATV racing series.
descripcion_larga: MX vs. ATV Extreme Limite brings high-octane racing to the French market. Featuring localized tracks and riders, it focuses on the thrill of extreme jumps and tight cornering in a variety of off-road environments.

objetivo: Survive the most untamed tracks and win the championship.
descripcion_corta: European release of the "Untamed" racing edition.
descripcion_larga: MX vs. ATV Untamed (Europe) challenges you to master various racing disciplines, from Supercross to Opencross. Battle for the lead against aggressive AI and use the touch screen for quick bike adjustments during the race.

objetivo: Survive the most untamed tracks and win the championship.
descripcion_corta: North American release of MX vs ATV Untamed.
descripcion_larga: Take the competition outdoors in MX vs. ATV Untamed (USA). Featuring a huge roster of licensed vehicles and challenging "Waypoint" races, it’s a comprehensive off-road experience that rewards daring stunts and precise driving.

objetivo: Nurture and treat adorable baby animals to health.
descripcion_corta: Baby animal rescue and care simulation.
descripcion_larga: My Animal Centre: Baby Animals (Europe) lets you care for the smallest patients. From polar bear cubs to kittens, use the stylus to feed, play with, and administer medical treatment to infants in this heartwarming multi-language title.

objetivo: Run a successful veterinary practice and heal pets.
descripcion_corta: Professional veterinary simulation for Europe.
descripcion_larga: My Animal Centre (Europe) puts you in the shoes of a vet. Diagnose illnesses, perform check-ups, and manage your clinic’s expansion while looking after dogs, cats, birds, and horses in a detailed 3D environment.

objetivo: Rescue and rehabilitate wild African animals.
descripcion_corta: Exotic wildlife vet simulation in Africa.
descripcion_larga: My Animal Centre in Africa (Europe) takes the vet genre to the savanna. Treat lions, rhinos, and zebras, ensuring they are healthy enough to be released back into the wild while managing your own rescue outpost.

objetivo: Rescue and rehabilitate wild African animals.
descripcion_corta: Nordic edition of the African wildlife sim.
descripcion_larga: This version of My Animal Centre in Africa provides localized text for Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, and Finnish players. Experience the same deep animal care mechanics and ecological missions in the African wild.

objetivo: Care for unique Australian animals in the outback.
descripcion_corta: Exotic wildlife vet simulation in Australia.
descripcion_larga: My Animal Centre in Australia (Europe) focuses on species like kangaroos and koalas. Learn about the unique needs of Australian wildlife while managing a specialized hospital in the heart of the outback.

objetivo: Care for a baby boy and guide his early development.
descripcion_corta: Realistic parenting and baby care simulation.
descripcion_larga: My Baby - Boy (Europe) allows you to experience the joys of motherhood or fatherhood. Feed, bathe, and dress your baby boy, and use the microphone and touch screen to interact with him as he grows and learns.

objetivo: Care for a baby boy and guide his early development.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the baby boy sim.
descripcion_larga: Nurture your virtual infant in My Baby - Boy (USA). This title features realistic baby reactions and a progression system that tracks your child's growth from birth to his first steps, requiring careful attention and love.

objetivo: Help your baby take their first steps and learn to talk.
descripcion_corta: Parenting simulation focused on toddlerhood.
descripcion_larga: My Baby - First Steps (USA) expands the parenting experience. Focus on the crucial developmental phase where your child begins to walk, talk, and interact more with the world through fun, educational mini-games.

objetivo: Care for a baby girl and guide her early development.
descripcion_corta: Realistic parenting and baby girl simulation.
descripcion_larga: My Baby - Girl (Europe) offers a heartwarming look at a child's first year. Use the stylus to rock her to sleep and the microphone to teach her her first words in this detailed, multi-language nurturing simulation.

objetivo: Care for a baby girl and guide her early development.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the baby girl sim.
descripcion_larga: Experience the milestones of a baby's life in My Baby - Girl (USA). Customize her nursery, choose her outfits, and ensure she stays happy and healthy through responsive and intuitive touch-screen interactions.

objetivo: Care for your babies and manage a growing family.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel to the My Baby series.
descripcion_larga: My Baby 2 - Boy & Girl (Europe) allows you to care for both genders. It features improved graphics, more clothing options, and deeper social interactions, making it a more comprehensive parenting simulator for DS fans.

objetivo: Raise your child and interact with other "baby" friends.
descripcion_corta: Third entry in the My Baby series with social features.
descripcion_larga: My Baby 3 & Friends (Europe) adds a social dimension to parenting. Take your child to the park to meet other toddlers, unlock new activities, and watch your baby develop a unique personality through play and education.

objetivo: Care for and train various breeds of cats and dogs.
descripcion_corta: Comprehensive pet ownership and training sim.
descripcion_larga: My Best Friends - Cats & Dogs (Europe) is a dual pet simulation. Choose your favorite breed, manage their diet and exercise, and teach them tricks to compete in pet shows, all while building a lasting bond with your furry friends.

nombre: My Boyfriend - Der Sommer Meines Lebens (Germany)
objetivo: Navigate the drama of high school and find your first love.
descripcion_corta: German-language teen romance and life sim.
descripcion_larga: My Boyfriend - Der Sommer Meines Lebens focuses on summer romance. Manage your social life, choose your outfits, and navigate the emotional highs and lows of a teen girl's summer vacation in this German exclusive.

nombre: My Boyfriend - Verliebt in einen Star (Germany)
objetivo: Date a famous celebrity and manage your social status.
descripcion_corta: German-language celebrity romance simulation.
descripcion_larga: In My Boyfriend - Verliebt in einen Star, you get to live every fan's dream. Balance your normal life with the glamour of dating a celebrity, managing your popularity and avoiding paparazzi in this engaging German title.

objetivo: Build relationships and manage your social life in a city.
descripcion_corta: Multi-language European teen romance sim.
descripcion_larga: My Boyfriend (Europe) allows players to create an avatar and navigate a vibrant social world. Work mini-games to earn money for fashion, interact with diverse characters, and find the perfect virtual partner.

objetivo: Build relationships and manage your social life.
descripcion_corta: German localized version of the teen dating sim.
descripcion_larga: This German version of My Boyfriend offers the complete social simulation experience. Focus on your character's personality and style to attract the best matches while enjoying a story-driven campaign about young love.

objetivo: Navigate a summer of romance and social activities.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the summer romance sim.
descripcion_larga: My Boyfriend (Summer of My Life) takes you on a seasonal adventure. Customize your character's look and personality to find "the one" while participating in summer activities and managing your daily schedule.

nombre: My Chinese Coach - Learn a New Language (USA)
gameplay: Language learning through lessons and drills.
objetivo: Learn Chinese (Mandarin) vocabulary and grammar.
descripcion_corta: Comprehensive Chinese language coach for the USA.
descripcion_larga: My Chinese Coach (USA) provides a structured path to learning Mandarin. Featuring over 10,000 words, handwriting recognition for characters, and speech comparison, it's a powerful tool for students and travelers.

nombre: My Chinese Coach - Learn to Speak Chinese (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
gameplay: Language learning through lessons and drills.
objetivo: Learn Chinese (Mandarin) vocabulary and grammar.
descripcion_corta: European edition of the Chinese language tutor.
descripcion_larga: Master the basics of Chinese with My Chinese Coach (Europe). This version includes localized instruction in multiple languages to help European speakers grasp the tones and characters of Mandarin through interactive games.

nombre: My Cooking Coach - Prepare Healthy Recipes (Europe) (NDSi Enhanced)
objetivo: Learn healthy recipes and manage your daily diet.
descripcion_corta: DSi enhanced healthy cooking coach for Europe.
descripcion_larga: My Cooking Coach (Europe) features over 240 healthy recipes. Use the NDSi camera to personalize your kitchen experience and follow step-by-step instructions from a virtual chef to improve your culinary skills and health.

objetivo: Learn to care for and maintain a pet snake.
descripcion_corta: Unique reptile care and habitat simulation.
descripcion_larga: My Dangerous Pet - Snake (Europe) is for fans of exotic animals. Learn about different snake species, manage their terrarium's temperature and humidity, and handle your pet carefully using the DS touch screen.

objetivo: Learn to care for and maintain a pet spider.
descripcion_corta: Unique arachnid care and habitat simulation.
descripcion_larga: My Dangerous Pet - Spider (Europe) allows you to keep virtual tarantulas and other spiders. Build their environment, feed them insects, and learn fascinating facts about these misunderstood creatures in a safe, digital format.

nombre: My Dog Coach - Understand Your Dog with Cesar Millan (Europe) (En,Fr,Es)
objetivo: Train your dog using the "Cesar Millan" method.
descripcion_corta: Professional dog training simulation based on the TV show.
descripcion_larga: My Dog Coach (Europe) features the world-renowned "Dog Whisperer." Learn to understand your dog's psychology, correct bad behaviors, and complete training exercises designed to create a balanced relationship with your pet.

objetivo: Manage a luxury boarding facility for dogs.
descripcion_corta: Dog hotel and care simulation for Europe.
descripcion_larga: My Dogs Paradise (Europe) tasks you with running the perfect retreat for dogs. Groom, feed, and play with different breeds to ensure they have a great stay, earning funds to upgrade your facility and decor.
