descripcion_larga: Experience the intense 2D action of Saikyou Ninja Daikesshuu. This entry features a massive amount of support characters and secret paths, making it a highly replayable title for Naruto fans in Japan.

nombre: Naruto Shippuu Den - Saikyou Ninja Daikesshuu 5 - Kessen! 'Akatsuki' (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the Akatsuki in the ultimate showdown.
descripcion_corta: The fifth and final 2D action game for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Kessen! 'Akatsuki' is the culmination of the 2D action series. Play as almost every major hero and villain in the series, featuring spectacular boss fights and a deep, multi-path story mode.

nombre: Naruto Shippuu Den - Shinobi Retsuden II (Japan)
objetivo: Master the 3D battlefield with Shippuden characters.
descripcion_corta: The second 3D fighter entry for the Japanese market.
descripcion_larga: Shinobi Retsuden II improves upon every aspect of the first game. With better graphics, a larger roster, and more fluid controls, it’s one of the most solid 3D fighting experiences available on the Nintendo DS.

nombre: Naruto Shippuu Den - Shinobi Retsuden III (Japan)
objetivo: Win the ultimate ninja tournament in 3D.
descripcion_corta: The third and final 3D fighter for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Shinobi Retsuden III is the definitive version of the 3D series. It features a massive roster including late-Shippuden characters and optimized gameplay that pushes the DS hardware to its limits.

objetivo: Master English vocabulary and grammar through practice.
descripcion_corta: Practical English learning method for French speakers.
descripcion_larga: Nathan Anglais: Methode Pratique offers a structured curriculum for learning English. Use interactive exercises and audio clips to improve your pronunciation and understanding in this specialized educational tool.

objetivo: Review key subjects for the 6th grade curriculum.
descripcion_corta: Comprehensive 6th grade educational trainer.
descripcion_larga: Nathan Entrainement 6e is designed to help French students transition to middle school. It covers math, French, and history through thousands of exercises that follow the national school program.

objetivo: Master basic reading, writing, and arithmetic for CE1.
descripcion_corta: Educational trainer for the second year of primary school.
descripcion_larga: This title provides a fun way for young students to practice their schoolwork. Nathan Entrainement CE1 uses mini-games and rewards to encourage children to master the fundamentals of the French curriculum.

objetivo: Review the 3rd year primary school curriculum (CE2).
descripcion_corta: Educational trainer for the third year of primary school.
descripcion_larga: Nathan Entrainement CE2 focuses on building a solid foundation in grammar and advanced arithmetic. It tracks student progress and adapts difficulty to ensure a balanced learning experience.

objetivo: Master the 4th year primary school subjects (CM1).
descripcion_corta: Educational trainer for the fourth year of primary school.
descripcion_larga: As school gets harder, CM1 helps students keep up. This Nathan trainer provides detailed explanations and interactive drills for complex math problems and French literature for older elementary students.

objetivo: Prepare for the transition to middle school (CM2).
descripcion_corta: Comprehensive 5th year primary school trainer.
descripcion_larga: Nathan Entrainement CM2 is the final step in the elementary series. It ensures students are ready for the next level by reinforcing all key subjects through a series of challenging and engaging digital lessons.

objetivo: Care for a panda cub and learn about the species.
descripcion_corta: National Geographic-branded panda simulation.
descripcion_larga: National Geographic: Panda (USA) lets you nurture a panda in a realistic 3D environment. Feed, play, and interact with your cub while accessing exclusive National Geographic photos and educational facts about panda conservation.

nombre: Nazonazo & Quiz - Ittou Nyuukon Q Mate! (Japan)
objetivo: Answer puzzles and riddles to win the championship.
descripcion_corta: Competitive quiz and riddle game for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Nazonazo & Quiz - Ittou Nyuukon Q Mate! challenges your brain with thousands of riddles. Compete against AI characters in various quiz formats that test your lateral thinking and general knowledge in this vibrant Japanese title.

nombre: Nazotte Oboeru - Otona no Kanji Renshuu - Kaiteiban (Japan)
objetivo: Master Japanese Kanji through repetitive tracing.
descripcion_corta: Revised edition of the adult Kanji trainer.
descripcion_larga: Nazotte Oboeru - Otona no Kanji Renshuu - Kaiteiban uses the DS touch screen to improve your handwriting. This "Revised" edition features a refined recognition engine and an expanded list of daily-use Kanji for adult learners.

nombre: Nazotte Oboeru - Otona no Kanji Renshuu - Kanzen Ban (Japan)
objetivo: Master Japanese Kanji through repetitive tracing.
descripcion_corta: Complete edition of the popular Kanji trainer.
descripcion_larga: The "Kanzen Ban" (Complete Edition) of this series offers the most comprehensive list of characters. Perfect for those looking to master complex Kanji, it includes advanced stroke order guides and evaluation modes.

nombre: Nazotte Oboeru - Otona no Kanji Renshuu (Japan)
objetivo: Master Japanese Kanji through repetitive tracing.
descripcion_corta: Tracing-based Kanji learning tool for adults.
descripcion_larga: Practice your penmanship with Nazotte Oboeru. This educational title focuses on "Adult Kanji," teaching not just how to read, but how to elegantly write the characters used in professional and social Japanese life.

objetivo: Become the most wanted driver and escape the police.
descripcion_corta: High-speed street racing and police chases.
descripcion_larga: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (Europe) brings the thrill of the chase to the DS. Win illegal street races, customize your performance cars, and evade intense police pursuit across a vast urban landscape.

objetivo: Become the most wanted driver and escape the police.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the street racing hit.
descripcion_larga: Own the streets in Need for Speed: Most Wanted (USA). Featuring a variety of licensed cars and a "Blacklist" of rivals to defeat, it combines arcade driving with the constant threat of law enforcement.

objetivo: Race through city streets with an emphasis on style.
descripcion_corta: High-octane arcade racer with a vibrant look.
descripcion_larga: Need for Speed: Nitro (Europe) features a unique visual style and accessible handling. Use power-ups, customize your ride with graffiti, and maintain top speeds to dominate your opponents in this fast-paced racer.

objetivo: Race through city streets with an emphasis on style.
descripcion_corta: Japanese release of the stylized NFS title.
descripcion_larga: Experience the flash and speed of NFS: Nitro in Japan. This version features the same intense arcade mechanics and deep customization, allowing players to "own" the track by leaving their mark on the city walls.

objetivo: Race through city streets with an emphasis on style.
descripcion_corta: North American release of Need for Speed: Nitro.
descripcion_larga: Speed, style, and strategy collide in NFS: Nitro (USA). Designed specifically for a pick-up-and-play experience, it offers various game modes and a massive selection of cars from supercars to muscle cars.

objetivo: Dominate professional racing events across the globe.
descripcion_corta: Shift from street racing to track-based simulation.
descripcion_larga: Need for Speed: ProStreet (Europe) focuses on precision and power. Compete in Drag, Drift, and Grip races, featuring deep engine tuning and a more realistic damage model than previous entries in the series.

objetivo: Dominate professional racing events across the globe.
descripcion_corta: Korean localized version of ProStreet.
descripcion_larga: Take your racing career to the professional level in Korea. NFS: ProStreet offers a refined control scheme and a career mode that takes you to the most prestigious racing venues in the world.

objetivo: Dominate professional racing events across the globe.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the track racer.
descripcion_larga: Prove you are the king of the track in NFS: ProStreet (USA). Use the touch screen for fine-tuning your vehicle's performance and experience the roar of the crowd in high-stakes legal racing events.

objetivo: Go undercover to infiltrate a criminal syndicate.
descripcion_corta: Story-driven street racing with police chases.
descripcion_larga: Need for Speed: Undercover (Europe) features a cinematic narrative. Complete high-speed missions, engage in "Highway Battles," and use your driving skills to bring down a global crime ring from the inside.

objetivo: Go undercover to infiltrate a criminal syndicate.
descripcion_corta: Korean localized version of Undercover.
descripcion_larga: Experience the drama and speed of Undercover in Korea. With a focus on high-speed chases and car customization, this title delivers a portable open-world experience with a strong narrative focus.

objetivo: Go undercover to infiltrate a criminal syndicate.
descripcion_corta: North American release of NFS: Undercover.
descripcion_larga: Take the wheel in NFS: Undercover (USA). Fight off aggressive police AI and rival gang members in a series of high-stakes missions, featuring a deep garage of licensed vehicles to unlock and upgrade.

objetivo: Rise to the top of the underground racing scene.
descripcion_corta: The sequel to the legendary tuner culture game.
descripcion_larga: Need for Speed: Underground 2 (Europe) brings the tuner scene to the DS. Focus on visual and performance upgrades as you win races in a neon-lit city to earn respect and sponsorship deals.

objetivo: Rise to the top of the underground racing scene.
descripcion_corta: North American release of Underground 2.
descripcion_larga: Customize every aspect of your ride in NFS: Underground 2 (USA). This title emphasizes the "bling" and performance of the early 2000s car culture, featuring a variety of race types and a pulse-pounding soundtrack.

nombre: Need for Speed Carbon - Own the City (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Take over the city's territories with your crew.
descripcion_corta: Tactical street racing with a focus on territory.
descripcion_larga: NFS Carbon: Own the City (Europe) introduces crew-based mechanics. Recruit wingmen to help you block rivals or find shortcuts as you fight to control the city's racing zones in this multi-language title.

nombre: Need for Speed Carbon - Own the City (USA)
objetivo: Take over the city's territories with your crew.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Carbon series.
descripcion_larga: Build your crew and conquer the streets in NFS Carbon: Own the City (USA). Featuring an exclusive story and specialized car classes, it offers a strategic layer to the traditional high-speed racing formula.

nombre: Negima! - Chou Mahora Taisen - Kattoiin, Keiyaku Shikkou Dechaimasuu (Japan)
objetivo: Win the Mahora Festival tournament with your team.
descripcion_corta: Anime-based RPG with tactical card-like combat.
descripcion_larga: Negima! Chou Mahora Taisen brings the popular manga to the DS. Form a team of students from Class 3-A and use specialized "Pactio" cards to unleash powerful spells and combos in grid-based battles.

nombre: Negima! - Chou Mahora Taisen Two - Checkiin, Zenin Shuugou! - Yappari Onsen Kichaimashitaa (Japan)
objetivo: Enjoy the festival and win hot-spring battles.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel to the Negima! RPG.
descripcion_larga: Checkiin, Zenin Shuugou! adds more characters and a new story set during a hot springs trip. Expect more fan-service, refined combat mechanics, and plenty of mini-games featuring the Negima! cast.

objetivo: Prank your neighbor without getting caught.
descripcion_corta: Humorous and strategic slapstick puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Neighbours from Hell (Europe) tasks you with setting traps in your neighbor's house. Use the stylus to combine items and create chaotic situations for a reality TV show, all while staying hidden.

objetivo: Run a successful bakery with cute cats.
descripcion_corta: Adorable cat-themed bakery simulation.
descripcion_larga: Neko Neko Bakery DS allows you to knead dough and bake bread with the help of feline friends. Manage your shop, learn new recipes, and serve happy customers in this charming Japanese management sim.

objetivo: Solve "Yooyuball" based puzzles to defeat enemies.
descripcion_corta: Competitive puzzle-board game set in Neopia.
descripcion_larga: Neopets Puzzle Adventure (Europe) uses a "Reversi" style mechanic for combat. Explore a story-driven world, collect "Petpets" to gain special abilities, and solve dozens of puzzles in this multi-language adventure.

objetivo: Solve "Yooyuball" based puzzles to defeat enemies.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Neopets puzzler.
descripcion_larga: Battle your way across Neopia in Neopets Puzzle Adventure (USA). Featuring deep customization and a rewarding progression system, it's a unique blend of board game strategy and RPG exploration.

nombre: Neoromance Game - Harukanaru Toki no Naka de - Yume no Ukihashi (Japan)
objetivo: Navigate a dream-like world and find your destiny.
descripcion_corta: Otome romance game from the Harukanaru series.
descripcion_larga: Yume no Ukihashi is a crossover title featuring characters from the first three Harukanaru Toki no Naka de games. Experience romantic interactions and strategic battles in a beautiful Heian-period setting.

gameplay: Quiz and trivia based on the TV show.
objetivo: Compete in various language and logic challenges.
descripcion_corta: Popular Japanese TV show adaptation for NDS.
descripcion_larga: Nep League DS brings the excitement of the Fuji TV quiz show to your hands. Compete in "Five League" and "Jet" modes that test your kanji knowledge, vocabulary, and quick thinking under pressure.

objetivo: Clear the screen by bouncing balls against bricks.
descripcion_corta: Innovative and artistic take on the Breakout genre.
descripcion_larga: Nervous Brickdown (Europe) reinvents the classic brick-breaker. Across 10 unique worlds, you'll use the stylus to draw platforms, blow into the mic to clear smoke, and fight massive bosses in this creative masterpiece.

objetivo: Clear the screen by bouncing balls against bricks.
descripcion_corta: North American release of Nervous Brickdown.
descripcion_larga: Experience 135 levels of frantic action in Nervous Brickdown (USA). Each world features a completely different visual style and gameplay mechanic, from retro 8-bit homages to physics-based water levels.

nombre: Net Ghost Pipopa - Pipopa x DS@Daibouken!!! (Japan)
objetivo: Save the digital world "Net" with Pipopa.
descripcion_corta: Cyber-world adventure featuring the Net Ghost trio.
descripcion_larga: Net Ghost Pipopa takes you inside the computer. Use the unique abilities of the ghosts Pit, Pot, and Pat to solve puzzles, battle viruses, and explore a colorful digital universe in this Japanese exclusive.

objetivo: Lead your high school baseball team to Koushien glory.
descripcion_corta: High-school baseball sim from the "Powerful" series.
descripcion_larga: Nettou! Powerful Koushien features the iconic big-headed characters. Manage your team's training, strategy, and roster to win the national championship in this deep and accessible sports simulation.

objetivo: Fit various shapes into a silhouette before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: Stylized and challenging Tangram puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Neves (Europe) is a test of spatial reasoning. Rotate and place seven wooden blocks to match hundreds of different outlines, ranging from simple animals to complex geometric patterns in a relaxing multi-language environment.

objetivo: Fit various shapes into a silhouette before time runs out.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the puzzle hit Neves.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Seven" (Neves backwards), this title offers a minimalist and addictive experience. With over 300 puzzles and a competitive multiplayer mode, it’s a perfect fit for fans of classic logic games.

objetivo: Win tickets and prizes across various fairground games.
descripcion_corta: DSi Enhanced carnival simulation for Europe.
descripcion_larga: New Carnival: Funfair Games (Europe) offers 30+ arcade-style attractions. Use the DSi camera to put yourself in the game and win virtual prizes in classic challenges like Milk Can Toss and Ring Fling in multiple languages.

objetivo: Win tickets and prizes across various fairground games.
descripcion_corta: North American sequel to the hit Carnival Games.
descripcion_larga: New Carnival Games (USA) brings more attractions and DSi-exclusive features. Customize your avatar, explore new themed zones, and enjoy a variety of motion and touch-screen based challenges for all ages.

objetivo: Master 1800 essential English words for students.
descripcion_corta: Educational English coach for Japanese middle schoolers.
descripcion_larga: New Chuugaku Eitango Target 1800 DS is a specialized learning tool. It uses interactive drills and pronunciation checks to help Japanese students memorize high-frequency English vocabulary for academic success.

objetivo: Master 1900 advanced English words for exams.
descripcion_corta: Advanced English vocabulary trainer for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Target 1900 DS focuses on high-level English for college entrance exams. It features a streamlined interface and progress tracking to ensure mastery of nearly 2000 advanced words and phrases.

objetivo: Learn English following the 1st-year school curriculum.
descripcion_corta: Interactive English course based on the popular textbook.
descripcion_larga: New Horizon - English Course 1 DS transforms the standard Japanese school textbook into an interactive experience. Practice listening, reading, and writing with audio support to build a strong English foundation.

objetivo: Learn English following the 2nd-year school curriculum.
descripcion_corta: Interactive English course for intermediate students.
descripcion_larga: Building on Course 1, Course 2 follows the Japanese second-year middle school English curriculum. It introduces more complex grammar and expanded vocabulary through engaging digital exercises.

objetivo: Learn English following the 3rd-year school curriculum.
descripcion_corta: Interactive English course for advanced students.
descripcion_larga: Course 3 prepares students for high school entrance exams. It covers the final year of middle school English in Japan, emphasizing reading comprehension and advanced sentence structure through daily practice.

objetivo: Break world records in various athletic events.
descripcion_corta: Konami's classic sports series returns for Japan.
descripcion_larga: New International Hyper Sports DS features 24 events including archery, swimming, and weightlifting. Compete against stylized characters or friends in this fast-paced arcade sports simulation optimized for the DS.

objetivo: Win gold medals in track and field events.
descripcion_corta: Modern revival of the classic Konami sports title.
descripcion_larga: New International Track & Field (Europe) offers a fresh take on the retro hit. Master the stylus-based controls to excel in sprints, jumps, and throws, featuring guest characters from other Konami franchises.

objetivo: Win gold medals in track and field events.
descripcion_corta: Korean localized version of the Konami sports game.
descripcion_larga: Compete in global athletic events in Korean. This version features the same robust character customization and competitive local/online multiplayer modes that defined this modern remake of the arcade classic.

objetivo: Win gold medals in track and field events.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the modern sports sim.
descripcion_larga: Go for the gold in New International Track & Field (USA). Featuring over 20 athletic events and a vibrant comic-book art style, it’s a high-energy competition that tests your speed and precision with the stylus.

objetivo: Win races in new, fan-made custom tracks.
descripcion_corta: Fan-made modification of Mario Kart DS.
descripcion_larga: New Mario Kart DS is a popular romhack that replaces standard tracks with custom-built courses. Experience fresh challenges and redesigned layouts while maintaining the tight gameplay mechanics of the original.

objetivo: Climb to the top of the towers to rescue your friends.
descripcion_corta: Remake of the classic arcade platformer for Japan.
descripcion_larga: New Rainbow Islands features the iconic bubble-shooting mechanics. Trap enemies in rainbows and explore vibrant, vertical levels with updated graphics and touch-screen features while climbing toward the goal.

nombre: New Shikakui Atama o Maruku Suru. DS - Kanzen Seiha Ketteiban (Japan)
objetivo: Sharpen your mind with varied logic and math puzzles.
descripcion_corta: Round your square head logic trainer for Japan.
descripcion_larga: This Kanzen Seiha Ketteiban (Determined Victory Edition) offers a massive collection of brain teasers. Solve logic, math, and language puzzles designed to improve cognitive flexibility for students and adults alike.

objetivo: Play through New Super Mario Bros. as Luigi.
descripcion_corta: Fan-made "Take 2" modification featuring Luigi.
descripcion_larga: New Super Mario Advance + Take 2 (Luigi) is a creative hack of NSMB DS. It features redesigned levels tailored for Luigi’s unique physics, offering a fresh experience for veteran Mario fans.

objetivo: Play through New Super Mario Bros. as Mario.
descripcion_corta: Fan-made "Take 2" modification featuring Mario.
descripcion_larga: This version of the "Take 2" hack focuses on Mario. It provides new level layouts, hidden secrets, and a higher difficulty curve than the retail game, breathing new life into the classic 2006 platformer.

objetivo: Play through New Super Mario Bros. as Toad.
descripcion_corta: Fan-made "Take 2" modification featuring Toad.
descripcion_larga: Play as Toad in this unique character-swap hack. Experience the redesigned stages of the "Take 2" series with Toad's sprites and modified physics, creating a fun alternative to the traditional Mario gameplay.

objetivo: Complete new levels in this fan expansion.
descripcion_corta: Unofficial "Advance" style sequel to NSMB DS.
descripcion_larga: New Super Mario Advance 2 (Hack) is a fan-created project that aims to deliver an "Advance" series feel. It features completely new level designs and mechanical tweaks for players looking for more content.

nombre: New Super Mario Bros. 5: Clone Tag Team
objetivo: Stop Bowser in this massive fan-made project.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the Clone Tag Team hack series.
descripcion_larga: New Super Mario Bros. 5: Clone Tag Team is a famous romhack known for high-quality level design. It introduces a "clone" mechanic where players must navigate two characters at once to solve puzzles.

nombre: New Super Mario Bros. 5: Clone Tag Team 2
objetivo: Stop Bowser in this massive fan-made project.
descripcion_corta: The acclaimed sequel to the Clone Tag Team hack.
descripcion_larga: Clone Tag Team 2 is widely considered one of the best NSMB DS hacks. It features custom assets, professional-grade level design, and a brand-new world map that rivals the quality of official Nintendo releases.

nombre: New Super Mario Bros. 5: Clone Tag Team 2 (Old Music)
objetivo: Stop Bowser in this massive fan-made project.
descripcion_corta: Version of Clone Tag Team 2 with classic music.
descripcion_larga: This specific version of Clone Tag Team 2 replaces the custom soundtrack with "Old Music" from previous Mario titles, catering to fans who prefer a more nostalgic auditory experience while playing the hack.

objetivo: Explore non-linear levels and find secrets.
descripcion_corta: Exploratory-focused romhack of NSMB DS.
descripcion_larga: New Super Mario Bros. Adventure (Exploratory) prioritizes hidden paths and item collection. The levels are designed to be played multiple times to uncover every secret, leaning more into the "metroidvania" style.

objetivo: Reach the flagpole in challenging new levels.
descripcion_corta: Normal-progression version of the Adventure hack.
descripcion_larga: This "Normal" version of the Adventure hack follows a more traditional linear progression. It features all-new stages that focus on tight platforming and classic Mario challenges without the emphasis on back-tracking.

objetivo: Experience the "Origins" of Mario's DS journey.
descripcion_corta: Nostalgic romhack with classic level themes.
descripcion_larga: New Super Mario Bros. Origins is a fan-made project that blends the mechanics of the DS game with the level themes and aesthetics of the NES and SNES eras, creating a "best of both worlds" experience.

objetivo: Win various touch-based mini-games against rivals.
descripcion_corta: European party game collection for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: New Touch Party Game offers a variety of pick-up-and-play challenges. Use the stylus for everything from card games to quick-reflex action mini-games, perfect for short play sessions and casual gaming.

objetivo: Improve cognitive skills with fun, visual exercises.
descripcion_corta: Early childhood brain training tool for Japan.
descripcion_larga: New Unou Kids DS (New Right Brain Kids) focuses on visual processing and memory. It features colorful, interactive exercises designed to help young children develop their "right-brain" potential through play.

objetivo: Solve daily puzzles from the famous newspaper.
descripcion_corta: The premier crossword experience for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: The New York Times Crosswords (Europe) features over 1,000 puzzles from the NYT archives. Use the touch screen to write letters directly into the grid, with multiple difficulty levels and a helpful hint system.

objetivo: Solve daily puzzles from the famous newspaper.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the NYT crosswords.
descripcion_larga: Carry the world's most famous crosswords in your pocket with The New York Times Crosswords (USA). This version includes the full history of Sunday puzzles and a clean, intuitive interface for word game fans.

objetivo: Rescue your kiwi friends from the zoo.
descripcion_corta: Japanese version of the New Zealand Story remake.
descripcion_larga: Control Tiki the Kiwi in New Zealand Story DS. This version updates the classic arcade game with a dual-screen map, new touch-screen mini-games, and revamped graphics while keeping the challenging 2D gameplay.

objetivo: Rescue your kiwi friends from the zoo.
descripcion_corta: European update of the Taito arcade classic.
descripcion_larga: New Zealand Story Revolution (Europe) features the "Revolution" gameplay enhancements. Use the stylus to aim your bow and solve environmental puzzles in this charming and difficult side-scrolling adventure.

objetivo: Rescue your kiwi friends from the zoo.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Kiwi adventure.
descripcion_larga: Tiki is back in New Zealand Story Revolution (USA). Fight through diverse worlds from the zoo to the ocean, utilizing various power-ups and weapons to save your friends in this colorful arcade revival.

nombre: Ni Hao, Kai-Lan - New Year's Celebration (Europe)
objetivo: Celebrate the Lunar New Year with Kai-Lan and friends.
descripcion_corta: Cultural and educational celebration for kids.
descripcion_larga: Ni Hao, Kai-Lan: New Year's Celebration (Europe) teaches Chinese culture and language through festive activities. Kids help prepare for the big parade, decorate, and learn about teamwork in a colorful, bilingual environment.

nombre: Ni Hao, Kai-Lan - New Year's Celebration (USA)
objetivo: Celebrate the Lunar New Year with Kai-Lan and friends.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Kai-Lan celebration.
descripcion_larga: Join Kai-Lan for the ultimate party in Ni Hao, Kai-Lan (USA). Featuring voice acting from the show, players complete rhythmic and logic mini-games designed to build preschool skills and cultural awareness.

nombre: Ni no Kuni - Shikkoku no Madoushi (Japan)
objetivo: Save your world and the parallel "Ni no Kuni" world.
descripcion_corta: Studio Ghibli collaborated RPG masterpiece.
descripcion_larga: Ni no Kuni: Shikkoku no Madoushi is a visual marvel. Featuring animation by Studio Ghibli and music by Joe Hisaishi, it utilizes a deep magic system where players draw runes on the touch screen to cast spells.

nombre: Nickelodeon Dora and Friends' - Fantastic Flight (USA) (En,Fr,Es,Nl)
objetivo: Fly with Dora and friends to complete missions.
descripcion_corta: Preschool aerial adventure based on Nickelodeon.
descripcion_larga: Dora and Friends' - Fantastic Flight (USA) features simple flight mechanics. Help Dora and her team navigate the skies, collect items, and solve math and logic problems tailored for younger players.

objetivo: Use "Mighty Math" to solve problems in Umi City.
descripcion_corta: Math-focused educational game for preschoolers.
descripcion_larga: Team Umizoomi (USA) focuses on patterns, shapes, and numbers. Join Milli, Geo, and Bot in various missions that encourage children to apply basic mathematical concepts to save the day in Umi City.

nombre: Nickelodeon Team Umizoomi and Dora's Fantastic Flight (USA)
objetivo: Complete missions with Team Umizoomi and Dora.
descripcion_corta: Two-in-one Nickelodeon educational collection.
descripcion_larga: This bundle combines Team Umizoomi and Dora's Fantastic Flight. It offers double the educational content, focusing on early childhood math and problem-solving skills with popular Nick Jr. characters.

objetivo: Stop Professor Calamitous and his army of Toybots.
descripcion_corta: Crossover action featuring various Nicktoons heroes.
descripcion_larga: Nicktoons: Attack of the Toybots (Europe) lets you play as SpongeBob, Danny Phantom, and more. Use a giant mechanical suit and unique hero abilities to fight through toy-themed levels and rescue captured friends.

objetivo: Stop Professor Calamitous and his army of Toybots.
descripcion_corta: Multi-language European release of Toybots.
descripcion_larga: This English/French edition of Attack of the Toybots features the same high-energy platforming. Switch between characters to utilize their specific powers and collect parts to upgrade your Toybot mech.

objetivo: Stop Professor Calamitous and his army of Toybots.
descripcion_corta: Spanish/Italian edition of the Nicktoons action game.
descripcion_larga: Localized for Southern Europe, this version of Toybots brings the battle against the toy army to Spanish and Italian fans. Master the mech-suit combat and defeat robotic versions of famous cartoon stars.

objetivo: Stop Professor Calamitous and his army of Toybots.

descripcion_corta: Third entry in the Ochaken room series.
descripcion_larga: Ochaken no Heya DS 3 focuses on outdoor activities and gardening. Plant flowers and create a beautiful park for your Tea Dogs to play in, alongside the classic room decoration and care mechanics.

objetivo: Manage a large garden and house for your Ochaken.
descripcion_corta: Revised version of the third Ochaken room sim.
descripcion_larga: The Rev 1 edition of the third installment provides minor updates to the gardening and decoration systems. It remains a fan-favorite for those who love the "healing" atmosphere of the Ochaken world.

objetivo: Complete your Ochaken collection and master the mini-games.
descripcion_corta: The fourth and most feature-rich Ochaken room sim.
descripcion_larga: Ochaken no Heya DS 4 is the definitive room-building experience. With the largest selection of items, dogs, and mini-games in the series, it offers endless hours of cute and cozy customization.

objetivo: Help Oden-kun solve problems in the Oden Village.
descripcion_corta: Quirky mini-game collection based on the surreal anime.
descripcion_larga: Oden-kun: Tanoshii Oden Mura features the characters from Lily Franky's famous book and anime. Complete strange and funny mini-games to help the village residents in this unique Japanese experience.

nombre: Odoru Daisousa-sen - The Game - Sensuikan ni Sennyuu Seyo! (Japan)
objetivo: Infiltrate a submarine and solve the case.
descripcion_corta: Detective adventure based on the hit Japanese film.
descripcion_larga: Odoru Daisousa-sen (Bayside Shakedown) brings the famous police drama to the DS. Use logic and investigation skills to navigate a high-stakes mission on a submarine, featuring iconic characters from the series.

nombre: Oekaki Puzzle Battle! - Yuusha Ou GaoGaiGar Hen (Japan)
objetivo: Solve Nonogram puzzles to battle GaoGaiGar enemies.
descripcion_corta: Nonogram (Picross) puzzle game with a mecha theme.
descripcion_larga: Oekaki Puzzle Battle! features the legendary King of Braves GaoGaiGar. Solve logic-based picture puzzles to launch attacks against mecha rivals, blending brain-teasing gameplay with classic anime action.

objetivo: Master the game of Go-Stop and become a pro.
descripcion_corta: Korean Hwatu (Go-Stop) card game simulation.
descripcion_larga: Ogwangui Darin DS features the traditional Korean card game. Compete against various AI opponents in high-stakes matches, featuring realistic rules and a campaign mode to become the master of Go-Stop.

nombre: Oheya o Kazarou - Koinu no Heya (Japan)
objetivo: Decorate rooms and raise adorable puppies.
descripcion_corta: Puppy-themed room decoration and care sim.
descripcion_larga: Oheya o Kazarou: Koinu no Heya focuses on the "cozy" side of pet ownership. Choose from various dog breeds, collect cute furniture, and design the perfect living space for your virtual puppy to play in.

objetivo: Master ballroom dancing to find your prince.
descripcion_corta: Princess-themed rhythm and romance game.
descripcion_larga: Ohimesama Debut (Princess Debut) follows a girl sent to a magical kingdom. Use the stylus to trace dance patterns in time with the music while building relationships with charming princes in this unique otome-rhythm hybrid.

objetivo: Build a peaceful life and make friends with animals.
descripcion_corta: Japanese original version of Animal Crossing: Wild World.
descripcion_larga: Oide yo Doubutsu no Mori is the seminal DS social sim. Fish, catch bugs, and interact with neighbors in real-time. This title defined the "slow life" genre on the handheld with its innovative 24-hour clock.

objetivo: Build a peaceful life and make friends with animals.
descripcion_corta: Revised Japanese edition of Animal Crossing.
descripcion_larga: This Revision 1 of the Japanese Animal Crossing includes technical fixes and improved stability for local wireless and Wi-Fi play, ensuring a smooth experience in your virtual village.

nombre: Oishiku Kiwameru Shokutsuu DS - Otona no Shuumatsu Henshuubu Gensen no Osusume Omise Jouhou Iri (Japan)
objetivo: Find the best restaurants in Japan based on expert reviews.
descripcion_corta: Gourmet restaurant guide for food enthusiasts.
descripcion_larga: Oishiku Kiwameru Shokutsuu DS is a digital encyclopedia for foodies. It features curated recommendations from "Otona no Shuumatsu" editors, covering top-tier dining spots across Japan with photos and maps.

objetivo: Learn to cook famous dishes from the Oishinbo manga.
descripcion_corta: Culinary guide based on the legendary gourmet manga.
descripcion_larga: Oishinbo: DS Recipe Shuu features over 100 recipes. Follow step-by-step instructions from the series' protagonists to master traditional Japanese cuisine and gourmet secrets in your own kitchen.

nombre: Ojaru-Maru DS - Ojaru to Okeiko Aiueo (Japan)
objetivo: Learn the Hiragana alphabet with Ojaru-Maru.
descripcion_corta: Preschool educational tool based on the anime.
descripcion_larga: Ojaru-Maru DS makes learning the basics of Japanese fun. Use the touch screen to trace letters and complete simple logic puzzles guided by the tiny prince and his friends.

nombre: OK! - First for Celebrity News - Puzzle Stars (Europe)
objetivo: Solve puzzles to unlock celebrity gossip and news.
descripcion_corta: Celebrity-themed puzzle game based on OK! Magazine.
descripcion_larga: OK! Puzzle Stars features word searches, crosswords, and logic puzzles. As you clear levels, you unlock high-res photos and "breaking news" about world-famous stars in this casual European title.

nombre: Okada Toshio no Itsumademo Debu to Omounayo - DS de Recording Diet (Japan)
objetivo: Track your daily food intake to lose weight.
descripcion_corta: Recording-based diet coach for health tracking.
descripcion_larga: Based on the famous "Recording Diet" method, this tool helps you log everything you eat. It provides calorie charts and motivational tips to help users maintain a healthy lifestyle on their DS.

objetivo: Clean the house and collect "Happy Points" to get rich.
descripcion_corta: The charming Chibi-Robo's return to the DS.
descripcion_larga: Okaeri! Chibi-Robo! tasks the tiny robot with cleaning a house using a vacuum and scrubbing brush. Manage your battery life, help the family with their problems, and earn money to buy upgrades.

objetivo: Participate in the world's most famous beer festival.
descripcion_corta: Oktoberfest-themed arcade and party games.
descripcion_larga: Oktoberfest: The Official Game (Europe) features traditional festival challenges like beer-mug sliding, bratwurst cooking, and rhythmic folk dancing in a cheerful, multi-language carnival atmosphere.

objetivo: Play through 26 different casual challenges.
descripcion_corta: Diverse collection of simple arcade mini-games.
descripcion_larga: OMG 26 - Our Mini Games (USA) offers a variety of quick-play tasks. From racing to logic puzzles, this collection is designed for short bursts of gameplay using the DS touch-screen controls.

objetivo: Battle rival pirates using "Spirit" cards.
descripcion_corta: High-energy One Piece fighting game for Japan.
descripcion_larga: One Piece: Gear Spirit features fast 1v1 combat. Use the bottom screen to activate "Spirit Cards" that trigger special moves or summon allies from the Straw Hat crew in this colorful brawler.

objetivo: Battle rival pirates using "Spirit" cards.
descripcion_corta: Korean localized version of Gear Spirit.
descripcion_larga: Fight for the title of Pirate King in Korean. This version brings the intense card-based combat and iconic anime attacks to Korean fans, featuring a robust cast of heroes and villains.

objetivo: Form a crew and conquer the "Grand Line."
descripcion_corta: The massive crossover fighter for European fans.
descripcion_larga: One Piece: Gigant Battle! (Europe) allows you to build a team of your favorite characters. Battle across interactive stages and use the "Gigant" system to trigger massive ultimate attacks in multiple languages.

objetivo: Form a crew and conquer the "Grand Line."
descripcion_corta: French localized version of Gigant Battle.
descripcion_larga: Join Luffy in this French edition of the hit fighter. Featuring localized text and the full roster of Straw Hat pirates, it’s a must-have for the large One Piece fanbase in France.

objetivo: Form a crew and conquer the "Grand Line."
descripcion_corta: German localized version of Gigant Battle.
descripcion_larga: Experience the explosive combat of Gigant Battle in German. Master the support system and unlock hidden characters by completing the deep "Pirate Grand Prix" world-map mode.

objetivo: Form a crew and conquer the "Grand Line."
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese release of Gigant Battle.
descripcion_larga: The first entry in the Gigant Battle series for Japan. Developed by Ganbarion, it sets the standard for handheld One Piece games with its high-quality sprites and chaotic, Smash-like gameplay.

nombre: One Piece Gigant Battle 2 - Shin Sekai (Japan)
objetivo: Survive the New World and become the Pirate King.
descripcion_corta: The expanded and refined sequel for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Gigant Battle 2 - Shin Sekai (New World) features a massive roster including characters from the Marineford and Fish-Man Island arcs. It offers deeper customization and larger-scale battles than the first game.

nombre: Onegai My Melody - Yume no Kuni no Daibouken (Japan)
objetivo: Help My Melody rescue her friends in the Land of Dreams.
descripcion_corta: Adorable platformer featuring the Sanrio character.
descripcion_larga: Onegai My Melody: Yume no Kuni no Daibouken is a colorful 2D adventure. Use My Melody’s magical umbrella to glide and defeat enemies across whimsical levels filled with Sanrio charm.

nombre: Oni Zero - Sengoku Ranse Hyakka Ryouran (Japan)
objetivo: Lead a team of warriors during the Sengoku period.
descripcion_corta: Dark fantasy tactical RPG for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Oni Zero features a unique blend of Japanese history and supernatural elements. Manage your units on a grid and use powerful "Oni" abilities to win the warring states' conflicts.

objetivo: Scan your voice to reveal your true emotions.
descripcion_corta: Unique emotional "scanning" tool for Japan.
descripcion_larga: Kokoro Scan uses the DS microphone to analyze the pitch and tone of your voice. Play social games with friends to see who is telling the truth or feeling stressed in this quirky experiment.

objetivo: Tap spirits (Ontama) to the beat to play music.
descripcion_corta: Colorful rhythm game with a puzzle twist.
descripcion_larga: Ontama: Onpu-tou Hen tasks you with tapping "spirits" on the touch screen in time with the music. Orchestrate a symphony of sounds to defeat rivals in a musical duel across a magical island.

objetivo: Tap spirits (Ontama) to the beat to play music.
descripcion_corta: North American release of Ontama.
descripcion_larga: Experience the frantic rhythm-action of Ontamarama (USA). Use the stylus and D-pad simultaneously to clear spirits and maintain your combo in one of the DS's most unique musical challenges.

objetivo: Guide Chibiterasu on a quest to save Nippon.
descripcion_corta: The beautiful sequel to the legendary Okami.
descripcion_larga: Ookami Den (Japan) stars a wolf pup named Chibiterasu. Use the "Celestial Brush" on the touch screen to draw objects, solve puzzles, and fight demons in a world inspired by Japanese ink-wash paintings.

objetivo: Guide Chibiterasu on a quest to save Nippon.
descripcion_corta: European release of the Okami sequel.
descripcion_larga: Experience the magic of Okamiden (Europe). Partner with diverse characters to navigate puzzles and engage in strategic combat, all rendered in the stunning cel-shaded style of the original series.

objetivo: Guide Chibiterasu on a quest to save Nippon.
descripcion_corta: North American release of Okamiden.
descripcion_larga: Embark on a grand adventure in Okamiden (USA). This title perfectly adapts the "Celestial Brush" mechanics to the DS touch screen, offering a heartwarming and visually breathtaking journey for fans of Okami.

nombre: Ookami to Koushinryou - Boku to Holo no Ichinen (Japan)
objetivo: Travel with Holo the Wise Wolf and trade goods.
descripcion_corta: Trading and romance sim based on Spice and Wolf.

nombre: Ookami to Koushinryou - Umi o Wataru Kaze (Japan)
objetivo: Cross the sea to new lands and find trade profits.
descripcion_corta: The second Spice and Wolf adventure for Japan.

nombre: Ookiku Furikabutte - Honto no Ace ni Nareru kamo (Japan)

descripcion_corta: Baseball game based on the Big Windup! anime.

objetivo: Explore a dwarven fortress and defeat an ancient evil.
descripcion_corta: Old-school dungeon crawler from id Software.

descripcion_corta: North American release of the fantasy RPG.
descripcion_larga: Enter the world of Orcs & Elves (USA). Developed by the creators of DOOM, this DS title offers a streamlined and addictive RPG experience where every move and attack counts in your quest to save the dwarven king.

objetivo: Protect the heroine and explore dangerous dungeons.
descripcion_corta: High-speed action RPG with a romantic twist.
descripcion_larga: Ore ga Omae o Mamoru (I'll Protect You) features fast-paced 2D combat. Explore a massive underground ruins system, upgrade your gear, and defend your companion in this stylish Japanese-exclusive adventure.

objetivo: Pilot historic fighter jets and complete air missions.
descripcion_corta: Handheld flight combat and dogfighting sim.
descripcion_larga: Ore no Sentouki (My Fighter Plane) lets you experience the thrill of the cockpit. Engage in high-altitude dogfights, manage your radar, and complete diverse missions in this technical flight simulator for Japan.

nombre: Original Frisbee Disc Sports - Ultimate & Golf (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
objetivo: Master the art of Frisbee in Ultimate and Golf modes.
descripcion_corta: Official Frisbee disc sports simulator for Europe.

nombre: Original Frisbee Disc Sports - Ultimate & Golf (USA)
objetivo: Master the art of Frisbee in Ultimate and Golf modes.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the Frisbee sports sim.

nombre: Original Rummikub, The - Brings People Together (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl) (DTP Entertainment AG)

nombre: Original Rummikub, The - Brings People Together (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl) (Games Factory Online)

nombre: Osawari Tantei - Ozawa Rina - Season 2 1-2 - Rina wa Mita! Iya, Mite nai. (Japan)

descripcion_larga: Help Mackenzie solve strange cases in the quiet town of Oslow. This stylized adventure game relies on the DS touch screen for environmental interaction, creating a charming and occasionally eerie atmosphere.

objetivo: Explore nature and learn about animals with Oscar.
descripcion_corta: Nature-themed educational adventure for kids.
descripcion_larga: Oscar der Ballonfahrer features a balloon-flying hero who travels to find rare animals. Solve logic puzzles and participate in activities that teach young players about zoology and the environment.

objetivo: Teach a parrot to speak and interact with you.
descripcion_corta: Voice-activated parrot care simulation.
descripcion_larga: Oshaberi Oumu (Chatty Parrot) uses the DS microphone for its core gameplay. Train your virtual parrot to mimic your voice and phrases, and care for its needs in this unique Japanese pet-sim experiment.

nombre: Oshare Majo Love and Berry - DS Collection (Japan)
objetivo: Collect cards and dance to win fashion contests.
descripcion_corta: Popular arcade card-game port for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: Oshare Majo Love and Berry brings the Japanese arcade phenomenon home. Customize your character's outfit with digital cards and perform rhythmic dance routines in this fashion-forward social simulation.

descripcion_larga: Oshare na Koinu DS combines the joy of having a pet with deep fashion customization. Choose from popular breeds, enter beauty contests, and design your puppy's look with hundreds of items.

objetivo: Become a fashion expert and find your first love.
descripcion_corta: Fashion-focused social simulation for girls.
descripcion_larga: Oshare Princess tasks you with balancing your social life and your wardrobe. Participate in fashion shows, manage your daily schedule, and interact with various characters to find romance in Japan.

objetivo: Master the fashion world and enter grand contests.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel to Oshare Princess.
descripcion_larga: Oshare Princess 2 features more clothing options, improved graphics, and new social scenarios. Continue your journey to become the most stylish girl in school while managing your budding romances.

nombre: Oshiri Kajiri Mushi no Rhythm Lesson DS - Kawai Ongaku Kyoushitsu Kanshuu (Japan)
objetivo: Learn music and rhythm with the Bottom Biter Bug.
descripcion_corta: Fun rhythm trainer based on the popular mascot.
descripcion_larga: Oshiri Kajiri Mushi (Bottom Biter Bug) offers a variety of musical mini-games. Guided by the famous mascot, players can improve their timing and musicality in a humorous and colorful Japanese environment.

descripcion_corta: Legendary rhythm game and fan favorite.
descripcion_larga: Osu! Tatakae! Ouendan is a high-energy rhythm game where you lead a male cheer squad. Use the stylus to hit targets in time with J-pop hits to help citizens overcome their problems in this iconic title.

descripcion_corta: Traditional Othello (Reversi) game for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: Othello de Othello DS provides a clean and professional way to play the classic strategy game. Featuring multiple AI difficulty levels and a local multiplayer mode, it's the perfect digital board game for logic fans.

objetivo: Connect lines to clear falling musical notes.
descripcion_corta: Musical puzzle game by the creator of Rez.

objetivo: Follow the magical girl adventure based on the anime.
descripcion_corta: Fantasy visual novel with interactive segments.
descripcion_larga: Otogi Juushi Akazukin features the characters from the popular anime series. Experience the story through branching dialogue paths and participate in mini-games to help Akazukin and her friends save the world.

nombre: Otome-teki Koi Kakumei - Love Revo!! DS (Japan)
objetivo: Lose weight and improve yourself to win your crush's heart.
descripcion_corta: Humorous "weight loss" dating sim for Japan.

nombre: Otona no DS Mystery - Izumi Jiken File (Japan)

descripcion_corta: Etiquette and social skill trainer for women.
descripcion_larga: Otona no Onna Ryoku Kentei tests your knowledge of manners, communication, and lifestyle. It features quizzes designed to measure your "feminine power" in various professional and social scenarios in Japan.

nombre: Otona no Renai Shousetsu - DS Harlequin Selection (Japan)
objetivo: Read classic Harlequin romance novels on your DS.
descripcion_corta: Interactive library of romance novels for adults.
descripcion_larga: DS Harlequin Selection turns your DS into an e-reader. It features several localized Harlequin novels with background music and atmospheric effects, perfect for fans of the world-famous romance series.

objetivo: Test your common sense and adult social skills.
descripcion_corta: General knowledge and "adult power" certification.
descripcion_larga: Otona Ryoku Kentei measures your ability to navigate adult life. From business manners to daily common sense, this title provides scores and advice to help you improve your social standing in Japanese society.

nombre: Otoshi Deka - Keiji-san, Watashi ga Yarimashita (Japan)
objetivo: Confess your "crimes" to solve the mystery.
descripcion_corta: Unique comedy-detective adventure for Japan.

nombre: Ougon no Taiyou - Shikkoku Naru Yoake (Japan)
objetivo: Prevent a new eclipse from destroying the world.
descripcion_corta: The epic third entry in the Golden Sun series.

descripcion_corta: Home improvement simulation for younger players.

objetivo: Manage the club and build relationships with the hosts.
descripcion_corta: High school romance based on the hit anime.
descripcion_larga: Ouran Koukou Host Club DS lets you play as Haruhi or a new protagonist. Manage the club's budget, choose host outfits, and navigate social scenarios to win the hearts of the famous Host Club members in this charming Japanese title.

descripcion_corta: Fan-made remastered crime epic for the NDS.
descripcion_larga: Outlaw's Paradise (Remastered) is a high-quality romhack that pushes the DS limits. Explore a custom open world, complete dangerous missions, and build your criminal empire in this enhanced fan project.

nombre: Over the Hedge - Beesten bij de Buren (Netherlands)

descripcion_corta: Ultra-hard "Hell" version ROM hack.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Pain
objetivo: Endure the suffering of the ultimate gauntlet.
descripcion_corta: Endurance-focused Mystery Dungeon challenge.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of the Spirit
objetivo: Uncover the mystery of the spiritual realm.
descripcion_corta: Story-heavy ROM hack with a deep narrative.
descripcion_larga: Explorers of the Spirit features a completely original script and custom cutscenes. Follow a spiritual journey that questions the nature of being a Pokémon in this acclaimed hack.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of the Spirit (Espanol)
objetivo: Uncover the mystery of the spiritual realm.
descripcion_corta: Spanish localization of Explorers of the Spirit.
descripcion_larga: Vive la épica historia de Explorers of the Spirit totalmente en español. Esta traducción permite a los fans hispanohablantes disfrutar de uno de los mejores guiones de la comunidad.

objetivo: Journey through a dreamlike fantasy world.
descripcion_corta: Surreal and artistic Mystery Dungeon hack.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Fantariem stands out with its unique atmosphere and custom music. It offers a shorter but more experimental narrative experience within the Sky engine.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Fount of Victory
objetivo: Reach the Fount of Victory to save your team.
descripcion_corta: Mission-based custom story hack.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Fount of Victory focuses on a specific quest across several new biomes. It features unique boss encounters and a tight, focused storyline.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Future of Hope
objetivo: Restore hope to a decaying future world.
descripcion_corta: Future-themed narrative expansion.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Future of Hope explores the "Dark Future" timeline with new perspectives. Help a group of resistance Pokémon change destiny in this emotional fan project.

objetivo: Collect the gifts of the future to fix the present.
descripcion_corta: Narrative sequel to the Future arc.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Future's Gifts acts as an epilogue to the main game's special episodes. It provides closure for several fan-favorite characters through challenging new dungeons.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Let The Music Play!
objetivo: Solve a mystery centered around musical notes.
descripcion_corta: Rhythm and sound-themed Mystery Dungeon hack.
descripcion_larga: Let The Music Play! is a creative hack where sound plays a key role in the story. It features a curated soundtrack and puzzles based on musical themes.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Memories Official Demo v.2.1.1
objetivo: Experience the beginning of a grand memory.
descripcion_corta: Official demo for an upcoming massive hack.
descripcion_larga: Memories (Demo v.2.1.1) showcases advanced technical features, including new UI elements and custom portraits, setting a new standard for Pokémon fan games.

objetivo: Follow Meowstic's journey in a custom tale.
descripcion_corta: Character-focused side story hack.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Meowstic's Tale tells a personal story centered on the psychic cat Pokémon. It features specialized move-pools and a narrative that explores the character's psyche.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - NOCTURNE OF A PRESUMED PRODIGY
objetivo: Unmask the truth behind a rising star.
descripcion_corta: Gothic and mysterious Mystery Dungeon hack.
descripcion_larga: NOCTURNE OF A PRESUMED PRODIGY features a dark, operatic story. Its unique writing style and atmospheric dungeon design offer a mature take on the Pokémon world.

objetivo: Help Nymble find his place in the world.
descripcion_corta: Story focused on a small bug Pokémon.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Nymble's Story is a heartwarming tale about growth and bravery. It restricts the player to specific Pokémon to create a unique tactical experience.

objetivo: Find a way back from a strange new world.
descripcion_corta: Isekai-style Mystery Dungeon adventure.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Otherworld places the protagonist in a bizarre dimension where the rules of the Pokémon world are warped. Survive and find the portal home in this strange hack.

objetivo: Stop the phantasms from consuming the world.
descripcion_corta: Ghost-themed mystery adventure (English).
descripcion_larga: PMD: Phantasime features custom ghost-type mechanics and a spooky narrative. Solve the mystery of the vanishing spirits in this highly polished fan game.

objetivo: Stop the phantasms from consuming the world.
descripcion_corta: German localization of Phantasime.
descripcion_larga: Phantasime (German) brings this hauntingly beautiful mystery to German-speaking players, featuring full translation of the complex custom script.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Sands of Time
objetivo: Navigate the shifting deserts of time.
descripcion_corta: Desert-themed tactical ROM hack.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Sands of Time focuses on endurance in harsh environments. Navigate heat-based mechanics and sandstorm dungeons in this challenging thematic expansion.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Seal of Ancients
objetivo: Unlock the ancient seal before it's too late.
descripcion_corta: Lore-heavy ancient history ROM hack.
descripcion_larga: Seal of Ancients explores the prehistoric era of the Pokémon world. Battle ancient forms and discover the origins of the mystery dungeons themselves.

objetivo: Enjoy a festive but dangerous celebration.
descripcion_corta: Event-based Mystery Dungeon mini-hack.
descripcion_larga: PMD: Shallow Shindig is a shorter, more lighthearted adventure focused on a festival gone wrong. It’s perfect for a quick, engaging playthrough with unique rewards.

objetivo: Protect the secrets of the soul.
descripcion_corta: Philosophical and narrative-driven hack.
descripcion_larga: Soul Secrets features a deep, dialogue-heavy story that branches based on player choices, a rare feature in the Mystery Dungeon hacking scene.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Special Episode 0: In A Dark Past
objetivo: Explore the origins of a villainous past.
descripcion_corta: Prequel story focused on a dark history.
descripcion_larga: Special Episode 0: In A Dark Past gives players a chance to see the world from a different perspective, filling in gaps in the original Explorers of Sky lore.

objetivo: Complete the game in record time.

objetivo: Lead a group of outcasts to redemption.
descripcion_corta: Team-focused character study hack.
descripcion_larga: Team Misfits follows a group of unlikely heroes who don't fit the standard rescue team mold. It features great character development and custom team tactics.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - The Bright Future
objetivo: Ensure a peaceful future for all Pokémon.
descripcion_corta: Optimistic and heroic narrative hack.
descripcion_larga: The Bright Future is a story of rebuilding after the events of the main game. Focus on community building and clearing out the remaining threats to the peace.

objetivo: Escape the lab and find your true identity.
descripcion_corta: Sci-fi themed Mystery Dungeon experiment.
descripcion_larga: The Experiment starts with the player as a lab subject. Use unique, "glitched" abilities to battle your way through artificial dungeons to find freedom.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - The Perfect Mix
objetivo: Find the perfect balance between two worlds.
descripcion_corta: Crossover-style Mystery Dungeon hack.
descripcion_larga: The Perfect Mix blends elements from different Pokémon generations and spin-offs into one cohesive experience, featuring a massive roster of available recruits.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - The Phantom Thief
objetivo: Catch the elusive thief before they disappear.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - The Weather Up There
objetivo: Investigate the strange weather anomalies.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Trials of the Person
objetivo: Overcome trials designed for a human heart.

nombre: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Waves Of Nostalgia
